generic.Defined scope/population: All loss notices arriving on phone, portal, mobile app and EDI agent feeds during the shift.
generic.In-scope period: Notices received between shift start and shift end, measured from the inbound receipt timestamp.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Channel, notice receipt time, claim number, handling unit and next-step text present on the acknowledgment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notice count in Genesys and the portal equals the acknowledgment count in ClaimCenter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acknowledgment document stored on the claim with send timestamp and delivery status.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Queued or failed acknowledgments logged with retry channel and final delivery outcome.
generic.Test population: All FNOL records created in the review window across the four intake channels.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Acknowledgment issued within 4 hours of notice receipt on every sampled notice.
generic.Exception handling path: SLA breaches and failed sends escalate to the Contact Center Supervisor for same-day remediation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Acknowledgment states claim number, handling unit and insured next steps on the elected channel.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim documents tab and the matching Genesys Cloud interaction record.

steps.title: Set the intake channel on the FNOL wizard channel field in Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: Open the FNOL wizard on the new notice in ClaimCenter.
Select Phone, Portal, Mobile App or EDI/Agent to match how the notice actually arrived.
Do not leave the channel at the wizard default.
Done when the channel field holds a controlled value matching the inbound source.
verify: Re-open the notice and read the channel field.
Pass when the stored channel matches the originating interaction record.

steps.title: Stamp notice receipt time from the Genesys Cloud inbound event
sop: Open the Genesys Cloud interaction and read the connect or submit timestamp.
Copy that value into the notice received date and time on the claim.
Never use the time keying finished as the receipt time.
Done when the receipt timestamp on the claim equals the inbound event time.
verify: Compare the claim receipt timestamp against the Genesys interaction log.
Pass when the two times agree to the minute.

steps.title: Store the EDI or agent transaction reference on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: For EDI or agent-feed notices open the inbound transaction payload.
Copy the broker submission reference number into the claim reference field.
Leave the field empty only for voice and portal notices.
Done when every EDI notice carries its inbound transaction reference.
verify: Filter EDI-channel claims and check the reference field is populated.
Pass when no EDI notice is missing its transaction reference.

steps.title: Compose the acknowledgment text in ClaimCenter with claim number and next steps
sop: Select the FNOL acknowledgment template for the line of business.
Confirm the merge fills claim number, assigned handling unit and claims contact number.
State plainly what the insured must do next and by when.
Remove any wording that implies a coverage or settlement position.
Done when the drafted text carries claim number, handling unit and next steps.
verify: Read the drafted acknowledgment end to end.
Check no unresolved merge tokens remain.
Pass when all three required elements are present and no coverage view appears.

steps.title: Send the acknowledgment on the insured elected channel via the Customer Self-Service Portal
sop: Read the insured recorded contact preference on the claim contact record.
Issue the acknowledgment on that channel as SMS, email or portal message.
Do not substitute a different channel for convenience.
Done when the acknowledgment is dispatched on the elected channel.
verify: Compare the send channel against the recorded preference.
Pass when the two match on the sampled notice.

steps.title: Confirm delivery status is Sent in ClaimCenter and retry failures
sop: Open the document record and read the delivery status.
Where status is Queued or Failed raise a retry activity on the alternate channel.
Record the final outcome against the original acknowledgment.
Done when every acknowledgment reads Sent or Delivered or carries an owned retry.
verify: List acknowledgments for the shift and filter on status.
Pass when no acknowledgment sits in Failed with no retry activity.

steps.title: Review the 4-hour acknowledgment SLA queue in Genesys Cloud and ClaimCenter
sop: Run the unacknowledged FNOL view sorted by notice receipt time.
Act first on notices past 75 percent of the 4-hour window.
Reassign or personally issue acknowledgments about to breach.
Note the review and any breach in the shift handover.
Done when no notice remains unacknowledged past the 4-hour window.
verify: Re-run the unacknowledged view at end of shift.
Pass when the view is empty of notices older than 4 hours.

generic.Defined scope/population: Loss notices whose loss date and location fall inside an active CAT event declaration or surge alert.
generic.In-scope period: The declared CAT event date window including the tail period defined on the event record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: CAT event code, PCS or catalogue number and CAT reserve category set on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: CAT-coded claim count in ClaimCenter matches the event aggregation roll-up count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Event record version and coding timestamp retained against each coded claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: In-window losses outside the event peril logged as not coded with the stated reason.
generic.Test population: All claims coded to the event plus in-window claims deliberately left uncoded.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every coded claim matches the event on status, date window, geography and peril.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed or borderline codings route to the Catastrophe & Exposure Manager for a decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Code applied only to Active events whose window and geography cover the reported loss.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter CAT event fields on the claim and the CAT event record in the claims platform.

steps.title: Open the active CAT event list in the claims management platform
sop: Filter the CAT event catalogue to status Active.
Read the peril, geography and date window on each candidate event.
Ignore events in Closed or Cancelled status.
Done when the candidate active event for this loss is identified.
verify: Re-read the status on the chosen event.
Pass when the event status is Active at the time of coding.

steps.title: Check the reported loss date against the event date window in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the loss date and time from the claim.
Compare it against the event start and end including any tail.
Do not code a loss dated outside the window.
Done when the loss date is confirmed inside or outside the window.
verify: Re-check the loss date against the event window.
Pass when the coded claim loss date sits inside the window.

steps.title: Confirm the loss location falls inside the declared CAT geography
sop: Read the validated loss location state, county and ZIP from the claim.
Compare it against the event geography band on the event record.
Use the loss address rather than the policy mailing address.
Done when the loss location is confirmed inside or outside the declared band.
verify: Spot-check the ZIP against the event geography list.
Pass when the coded claim ZIP appears on the event geography list.

steps.title: Confirm the reported peril matches the event peril before coding
sop: Read the cause of loss recorded on the claim.
Compare it with the event peril such as wind, flood or wildfire.
Where the peril differs leave the claim uncoded.
Done when the peril comparison is made and recorded.
verify: Review in-window uncoded claims for a stated peril mismatch reason.
Pass when every uncoded in-window claim carries that reason.

steps.title: Apply the CAT event code and PCS catalogue number on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Select the event from the CAT event picker rather than typing a description.
Confirm the PCS or catalogue number populates on the event field.
Save the claim and confirm no validation error is returned.
Done when the CAT event code and catalogue number are stored on the claim.
verify: Re-open the claim and read the CAT event fields.
Check the catalogue number is a number and not free text.
Pass when both fields hold controlled values.

steps.title: Confirm the reserve category flips to the CAT bucket in the claims platform
sop: Open the reserve category field after coding is saved.
Confirm it now reads the CAT bucket for the event.
Where it has not flipped raise the issue rather than editing around it.
Done when the claim reserve category reads the CAT bucket.
verify: Check the claim appears in the next event aggregation roll-up.
Pass when the claim is counted in the event aggregate view.

steps.title: Escalate borderline codings to the Catastrophe & Exposure Manager
sop: Review the daily list of borderline and rejected CAT codings.
Decide code or do not code for each and record the reason.
Correct any claim coded to a Closed or Cancelled event.
Done when every borderline item carries a recorded decision.
verify: Re-run the borderline list after the review.
Pass when no item is left without a decision and reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every caller or submitter reporting a loss against a policy through any intake channel.
generic.In-scope period: The intake interaction itself, from first contact to the point identity is resolved.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Verification result flag, relationship to insured and matched identifiers on the contact record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of intake interactions equals count of contact records carrying a verification result.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Verification outcome stamped on the claim contact record with the time of the check.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed verifications logged as unverified third-party notices with restricted disclosure applied.
generic.Test population: All reporting-party contact records created on claims in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: At least two identifiers matched against the policy record on every verified submitter.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed or partial verification continues as restricted-disclosure intake rather than being abandoned.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Verification status and relationship to insured stored as fields, not free-text call notes.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim contact record with the PolicyCenter policy record used for matching.

steps.title: Retrieve the policy record in Guidewire PolicyCenter for the quoted policy
sop: Search PolicyCenter by policy number or named insured and loss address.
Open the version of the policy in force on the reported loss date.
Confirm the record found is the right policy before asking any question.
Done when the in-force policy record is open alongside the notice.
verify: Compare the policy effective dates against the loss date.
Pass when the open policy was in force on the loss date.

steps.title: Match at least two identifiers against the policy record
sop: Ask for named insured, policy number, risk address, date of birth or last four of the payment method.
Match at least two of these against PolicyCenter without prompting the caller with the answer.
Record which identifiers were matched.
Done when two or more identifiers are matched or the attempt has failed.
verify: Read the recorded identifier list on the contact record.
Pass when two or more identifiers are shown as matched.

steps.title: Capture the caller relationship on the ClaimCenter contact record
sop: Set the relationship as insured, additional insured, driver, agent or broker, or third-party claimant.
Use the controlled relationship field rather than the call summary.
Ask directly rather than assuming from the phone number.
Done when the relationship value is stored on the contact record.
verify: Open the contact record and read the relationship field.
Pass when the relationship holds a controlled value.

steps.title: Check the producer code for agent or broker submissions against PolicyCenter
sop: Read the producer code carried on the agent or broker notice.
Compare it against the producer of record on the PolicyCenter policy.
Query mismatches with the submitting agency before proceeding.
Done when the producer code is confirmed matched or queried.
verify: Sample agent-channel notices and compare producer codes.
Pass when each matches the producer of record or carries a query.

steps.title: Set the verification result flag on the claim contact record in ClaimCenter
sop: Set the verification status to Passed, Partial or Failed.
Do not leave the flag blank when the interaction ends.
Add the short reason where the result is Partial or Failed.
Done when the verification flag holds an explicit result.
verify: Filter contacts created today on verification status.
Pass when no reporting party is left with a blank verification status.

steps.title: Apply restricted disclosure where verification failed
sop: Continue the intake as an unverified third-party notice rather than ending the call.
Withhold coverage limits, deductibles and policy financials from the caller.
Note in the CRM interaction that restricted disclosure was applied.
Done when the notice is logged with restricted disclosure in force.
verify: Review Failed-verification claims for disclosure of policy financials.
Pass when no limits or financials were released on those notices.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every reporting party who completes an FNOL interaction on any intake channel.
generic.In-scope period: The intake interaction, ending when the claim number has been communicated and confirmed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: ClaimCenter claim number, service phone number and service hours given to the reporting party.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims created in the window equal the outbound claim-number communications issued.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Written claim-number notification retained on the claim with its send timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicate claim numbers issued in error logged and closed against the surviving claim.
generic.Test population: All claims created or matched during the review window across channels.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The issued number is the ClaimCenter claim number on every sampled interaction.
generic.Exception handling path: Read-back failures or wrong numbers quoted are corrected on the same interaction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim number communicated verbally and in writing on the insured elected channel.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim header and the outbound acknowledgment document on the claim.

steps.title: Confirm whether an existing claim number applies before quoting one
sop: Check whether the notice was matched to an existing claim in ClaimCenter.
Where matched quote the pre-existing claim number.
Do not create a second claim number for the same event.
Done when the correct claim number to quote is identified.
verify: Check the claim for a duplicate on the same policy, loss date and location.
Pass when only one claim number exists for the event.

steps.title: Read the ClaimCenter claim number from the claim header, not the exposure id
sop: Open the claim header in ClaimCenter and read the claim number field.
Do not quote the exposure identifier or the activity id.
Check the format matches the standard claim number pattern.
Done when the correct claim number is in hand.
verify: Compare the number quoted against the claim header value.
Pass when the two are identical.

steps.title: Read the number back and have the reporting party repeat it on the Genesys Cloud call
sop: Read the full claim number slowly to the reporting party.
Ask them to repeat it back before moving on.
Repeat the read-back if the repetition is wrong.
Done when the party has repeated the number correctly.
verify: Check the interaction note records a successful read-back.
Pass when a read-back confirmation is recorded on the interaction.

steps.title: Give the claims service phone number and hours alongside the claim number
sop: State the claims service phone number and the hours of operation.
Point to the self-service portal as an alternative route.
Record that this information was given.
Done when service contact details have been communicated.
verify: Read the interaction summary for the service details given.
Pass when phone number and hours are both recorded as given.

steps.title: Push the claim number in writing on the insured elected channel
sop: Trigger the written claim-number notification from ClaimCenter.
Send on the recorded preference of SMS, email or portal message.
Do not rely on the phone call alone.
Done when the written notification is dispatched.
verify: Open the claim documents and read the delivery status.
Pass when the written notification shows Sent or Delivered.

steps.title: Close any duplicate claim number opened in error
sop: Search for other open claims on the same policy, loss date and location.
Close any duplicate with the close reason Duplicate.
Cross-reference the duplicate to the surviving claim number.
Done when only one open claim number exists for the event.
verify: Re-run the duplicate search on the policy and loss date.
Pass when a single open claim is returned.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every loss notification taken at intake that must become a claim record in ClaimCenter.
generic.In-scope period: The shift in which the notice was received, with no FNOL carried over in Draft.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, named insured, loss date, loss description, line of business and coverage type.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notices handled during the shift equal FNOL records created in the claims platform.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Created claim record retained with creation timestamp and the creating user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Losses outside the policy period logged with a coverage-question flag and a disposition.
generic.Test population: All FNOL records created during the review window on the claims platform.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No FNOL left in Draft status at end of shift.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-period or incomplete notices still log and route to an information-request activity.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim exists in Open status with policy, loss date and loss description populated.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim record and its audit history in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Create the new loss record against the policy in Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: Search for the policy and open a new loss against it.
Confirm the named insured on the policy matches what the caller reported.
Do not create the loss against a policy you have not opened.
Done when a new loss record exists linked to the correct policy.
verify: Open the claim and read the linked policy number.
Pass when the linked policy matches the reported policy.

steps.title: Populate policy number, named insured, loss date and loss description
sop: Enter the loss date as a discrete date value.
Type the loss description in the narrative field in the insured own terms.
Leave no mandatory identification field blank.
Done when all four core fields hold values.
verify: Run the FNOL validation on the record.
Pass when no mandatory field error is returned.

steps.title: Check the loss date against policy inception and expiry in the claims platform
sop: Compare the loss date against the policy effective and expiry dates.
Where the loss falls outside the period set the coverage-question flag.
Do not silently adjust the loss date to make it fit.
Done when the loss date is confirmed in period or flagged.
verify: Filter claims where the loss date is outside the policy period.
Pass when each carries a coverage-question flag.

steps.title: Select the line of business and coverage type matching the policy
sop: Read the coverages carried on the policy for the loss date.
Select the line of business and coverage type that the notice was written against.
Query any notice reported against a coverage the policy does not carry.
Done when line of business and coverage type are set and consistent.
verify: Compare the selected coverage against the policy coverage list.
Pass when the selected coverage appears on the policy.

steps.title: Record the reporting party contact number and preferred contact method
sop: Capture a callable phone number for the reporting party.
Set the preferred contact method so the adjuster can make first contact.
Confirm the number back with the caller.
Done when a callable number and a contact preference are stored.
verify: Open the contact record and read both fields.
Pass when the number and preference are both populated.

steps.title: Submit the FNOL out of Draft into Open status
sop: Submit the FNOL rather than saving it as a draft.
Resolve any validation error rather than leaving the record parked.
Confirm the status now reads New or Open.
Done when the record is out of Draft.
verify: Run the Draft FNOL view at end of shift.
Pass when the view returns no records for the shift.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every logged loss notification requiring receipt date, time and channel metadata.
generic.In-scope period: Notices received in the reporting day including after-hours and overflow vendor intake.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Notice received date and time, reported-to-company date and controlled channel value.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Genesys and portal inbound counts reconcile to claims carrying a matching receipt timestamp.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: System-captured receipt timestamp retained with the source interaction reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Re-keyed vendor notices logged with the original vendor receipt time and the re-key time.
generic.Test population: All claims created in the reporting day across phone, portal, mobile, EDI and email.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim where the reported date and time is later than the claim creation timestamp.
generic.Exception handling path: Timestamp anomalies route to the Claims Analyst for correction before SLA reporting runs.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Receipt metadata captured from the inbound event and driving the acknowledgment SLA clock.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim metadata fields and the Genesys Cloud interaction log.

steps.title: Read the inbound event timestamp from Genesys Cloud or the portal submission
sop: Open the source interaction for the notice.
Read the call connect, portal submit or EDI receipt time.
Do not use the time you finished keying the record.
Done when the true inbound event time is identified.
verify: Compare the identified time against the interaction log entry.
Pass when the two agree.

steps.title: Enter the notice received date and time on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Enter the date and time into the notice received fields.
Enter time of day rather than leaving a midnight default.
Save and confirm no validation error is raised.
Done when the received date and time are stored on the claim.
verify: Re-open the claim and read the received timestamp.
Pass when it matches the inbound event time.

steps.title: Set the channel field to a controlled value in ClaimCenter
sop: Select Phone, Portal, Mobile App, EDI/Agent or Email.
Do not type a free-text channel description.
Match the value to the actual inbound route.
Done when the channel field holds one controlled value.
verify: Filter today claims by channel and look for blanks or free text.
Pass when every claim carries a controlled channel value.

steps.title: Carry across the original vendor receipt time for after-hours intake
sop: Open the overflow or BPO vendor intake record for the notice.
Copy the vendor receipt time into the notice received field.
Record the re-key time separately rather than overwriting receipt time.
Done when the vendor receipt time is the stored receipt time.
verify: Sample overnight vendor notices re-keyed the next morning.
Pass when receipt time predates the re-key time on each.

steps.title: Confirm the reported-to-company date drives the SLA clocks on the claim
sop: Open the SLA clock panel on the claim.
Confirm the acknowledgment and contact clocks start from the reported date.
Raise a configuration defect if a clock starts from claim creation.
Done when both clocks are shown running from the reported date.
verify: Compare clock start times against the reported date on sampled claims.
Pass when both clocks start from the reported date.

steps.title: Check time zone consistency between receipt time and loss location
sop: Read the stored time zone against the loss location state.
Correct late-night notices that have shifted a calendar day.
Record any correction made and its reason.
Done when receipt time and loss location time zone agree.
verify: Sample notices received between 22:00 and 02:00 local.
Pass when no sampled notice has shifted a day.

steps.title: Run the timestamp anomaly report on the day intake in the claims platform
sop: List claims where reported date and time exceeds claim creation time.
Investigate each and correct the source field.
Log anomalies that come from a system defect for configuration fix.
Done when the anomaly list is worked to zero or fully logged.
verify: Re-run the anomaly report after corrections.
Pass when the report returns no unexplained rows.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every inbound notice that must either match an existing claim or open a new claim number.
generic.In-scope period: Notices handled in the shift, with duplicate searching done before any claim is created.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, loss date, loss cause and the recorded duplicate search result on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: New claims created plus notices matched to existing claims equals notices handled.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Duplicate search result retained on the claim with the search timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicates opened in error closed as Duplicate and cross-referenced to the surviving claim.
generic.Test population: All claims created or updated by intake in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No two open claims share the same policy, loss date and loss cause.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous match or no-match cases escalate to the Claims Coordinator before creation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Either a link to the matched claim or a documented no-match search result exists.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim record, its duplicate search note and the PolicyCenter policy history.

steps.title: Run the duplicate search on policy number and loss date range in ClaimCenter
sop: Search open and recently closed claims on the policy number.
Widen the loss date range by a few days either side of the reported date.
Run the search before pressing Create.
Done when the duplicate search has been executed and read.
verify: Check the claim carries a duplicate search note.
Pass when the search result is recorded on the claim.

steps.title: Record the search outcome as matched or no-match on the claim
sop: Write the search result as a note including what was searched.
State clearly whether a match was found.
Do not leave the outcome implied by the absence of a note.
Done when the outcome is written on the claim.
verify: Read the note on the sampled claim.
Pass when the note names the search criteria and the result.

steps.title: Add new information to the matched claim rather than opening a second number
sop: Open the matched claim in ClaimCenter.
Add the new facts as a note or a new exposure on that claim.
Do not create a second claim number for the same event.
Done when the new information sits on the existing claim.
verify: Search for a second claim on the same policy and loss date.
Pass when no second open claim exists.

steps.title: Open a separate claim for a genuinely new event on the same policy
sop: Compare the loss date and loss cause with the earlier claim.
Where both differ open a separate claim.
Note on both claims why they are distinct events.
Done when the new event has its own claim with a distinguishing note.
verify: Read the distinguishing note on both claims.
Pass when each states the differing loss date or cause.

steps.title: Create one claim with per-claimant exposures for multi-party losses
sop: For multi-vehicle or multi-claimant losses open a single claim.
Add a separate exposure for each claimant on that claim.
Do not create one claim per caller on the same event.
Done when a single claim carries an exposure per claimant.
verify: Count claims raised for the multi-party event.
Pass when one claim exists with the expected exposure count.

steps.title: Close duplicates opened in error and cross-reference the survivor
sop: Review the daily potential-duplicate report from ClaimCenter.
Close each confirmed duplicate with reason Duplicate.
Cross-reference it to the surviving claim number on both records.
Done when every confirmed duplicate is closed and cross-referenced.
verify: Re-run the potential-duplicate report.
Pass when no open duplicate pair remains.

generic.Defined scope/population: All intake queues covering phone, portal, email and EDI work waiting to be handled.
generic.In-scope period: The supervisor shift, reviewed at intervals rather than only at end of day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Longest-wait value, queue SLA, staffed headcount and skill profile per intake queue.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Queue item counts in Genesys and ClaimCenter reconcile to the BI intake backlog report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rebalance actions and queue volumes retained in the timestamped shift handover note.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Queues breaching SLA logged with the action taken and the residual backlog at handover.
generic.Test population: All intake queues live during the shift including the after-hours overflow queue.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Longest wait in each queue stays inside its published SLA and abandonment stays under 5 percent.
generic.Exception handling path: Sustained breach triggers overflow to the after-hours or BPO intake vendor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No unassigned FNOL older than the intake SLA remains at end of shift.
generic.Evidence location: Genesys Cloud queue dashboards, ClaimCenter unassigned FNOL view and the BI intake report.

steps.title: Read the longest-wait value per intake queue on the Genesys Cloud dashboard
sop: Open the intake queue dashboard covering phone, portal, email and EDI.
Read the oldest waiting item in each queue against its SLA clock.
Note any queue past 75 percent of its window.
Done when every queue has a current longest-wait reading.
verify: Compare the readings against the published SLA per queue.
Pass when each queue reading is recorded against its SLA.

steps.title: Work items past 75 percent of the SLA window first
sop: Sort each breaching queue by oldest waiting item.
Assign or personally handle the items nearest breach.
Do not start with the newest arrivals.
Done when no item sits past 75 percent without an owner.
verify: Re-read the oldest waiting item after the intervention.
Pass when the oldest item is inside the SLA window.

steps.title: Move handlers between queues using the Genesys skill routing profile
sop: Adjust the skill routing profile to add capacity to the pressured queue.
Do not hand-assign individual claims to handlers.
Confirm the profile change has taken effect on live routing.
Done when the routing profile reflects the new capacity split.
verify: Check the queue staffing figures after the profile change.
Pass when staffed capacity moved to the pressured queue.

steps.title: Check portal and EDI backlogs are not ageing behind voice traffic
sop: Compare portal and EDI queue ages against the voice queue age.
Where back-office queues are ageing pull handlers off voice overflow.
Confirm ClaimCenter unassigned FNOLs from those channels are reducing.
Done when back-office queue ages are within their SLA.
verify: Read the portal and EDI queue ages after rebalance.
Pass when both sit inside their published SLA.

steps.title: Trigger overflow to the after-hours or BPO intake vendor before breach
sop: Watch the abandonment rate against the 5 percent threshold.
Trigger vendor overflow before the threshold is breached.
Record the trigger time and the volume diverted.
Done when overflow is active and its volume is recorded.
verify: Read the abandonment rate after overflow starts.
Pass when abandonment stayed under 5 percent for the shift.

steps.title: Record rebalance actions and volumes in the shift handover
sop: Write the queue positions, actions taken and residual backlog into the handover.
Name any queue still under pressure at handover.
Attach the BI intake report snapshot used.
Done when the handover note is published to the next supervisor.
verify: Read the handover note for queue positions and actions.
Pass when volumes, actions and residual backlog are all stated.

steps.title: Clear unassigned FNOLs older than the intake SLA in ClaimCenter
sop: Run the unassigned FNOL view sorted oldest first.
Assign each ageing item to an available handler.
Escalate anything that cannot be cleared to the Ops Manager.
Done when the view holds no item older than the intake SLA.
verify: Re-run the unassigned FNOL view at end of shift.
Pass when no item exceeds the intake SLA.

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims carrying an active CAT event code that must reach the surge queue and CAT adjuster pool.
generic.In-scope period: The routing run covering claims coded to the event since the previous run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: CAT event code, target queue, assigned CAT lane and named adjuster on each routed claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: CAT-coded claim count equals claims present in the CAT surge queue plus the exception queue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Routing outcome and timestamp retained on the claim workflow history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims failing CAT routing land in the exception queue with a named owner and disposition.
generic.Test population: All CAT-coded claims processed by the routing run in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No CAT-coded claim remains in a non-CAT queue after the routing run completes.
generic.Exception handling path: Routing failures escalate to the Catastrophe & Exposure Manager for manual placement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: CAT claims assigned to the CAT surge group with a named adjuster licensed for the loss state.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter assignment history and the CAT queue view in the workflow tool.

steps.title: List CAT-coded claims awaiting routing in Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: Filter claims by the active CAT event code and unrouted status.
Exclude claims already assigned to the CAT surge queue.
Note the total count before starting the run.
Done when the routing worklist is produced with a starting count.
verify: Compare the worklist count against CAT-coded claims created since the last run.
Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Move CAT-coded claims into the CAT surge queue in the workflow tool
sop: Route each listed claim to the CAT surge queue rather than the territory queue.
Do not leave CAT claims on standard routing because the territory looks familiar.
Confirm the queue shows the new arrivals.
Done when every listed claim sits in the CAT surge queue.
verify: Re-run the CAT-coded filter against queue membership.
Pass when no CAT-coded claim sits in a non-CAT queue.

steps.title: Check CAT adjuster licensing for the affected states before assignment
sop: Open the CAT adjuster pool roster for the event.
Confirm each adjuster holds an active or emergency licence for the loss state.
Remove unlicensed adjusters from the assignment pool.
Done when the assignable pool holds only licensed adjusters.
verify: Sample assignments and check licence status for the loss state.
Pass when every assigned adjuster is licensed for that state.

steps.title: Pull life-safety and habitability cases to the priority CAT lane
sop: Identify claims flagged fire loss, uninhabitable dwelling or injury.
Move those claims ahead of routine property damage in the CAT lane.
Record why each claim was prioritised.
Done when priority cases sit at the front of the CAT lane.
verify: Read the CAT lane ordering against the priority flags.
Pass when flagged cases precede routine property damage.

steps.title: Route commercial and large-account CAT claims to the large-loss CAT lane
sop: Check the line of business and account tier on each CAT claim.
Send commercial and large-account claims to the large-loss CAT lane.
Do not leave them in the personal-lines surge pool.
Done when commercial and large-account claims sit in the large-loss lane.
verify: Filter CAT claims by account tier and read the assigned lane.
Pass when no large-account claim sits in the personal-lines pool.

steps.title: Work the CAT routing exception queue to a named owner
sop: Open the routing exception queue in the workflow tool.
Assign each failed claim to a named handler with a reason.
Do not leave failed claims unassigned overnight.
Done when every exception carries a named owner.
verify: Re-open the exception queue after the run.
Pass when no exception item is unassigned.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every newly created claim requiring an automated acknowledgment to the reporting party.
generic.In-scope period: Claims created in the reporting day, acknowledged before the acknowledgment SLA expires.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim number, loss date, assigned unit and claims contact number merged into the template.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims created equals acknowledgments generated plus documented suppression exceptions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acknowledgment document retained on the claim with template version and send timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bounced sends logged with an alternate-channel retry activity and its outcome.
generic.Test population: All acknowledgment documents produced against claims in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No acknowledgment carrying unresolved merge fields or a coverage opinion is released.
generic.Exception handling path: Delivery failures raise a retry activity owned by the Contact Center Supervisor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Acknowledgment status is Sent with the claim number and concrete next steps in the body.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter document record, the CRM send log and the portal message thread.

steps.title: Select the acknowledgment template for the line of business in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the correspondence panel on the new claim.
Pick the FNOL acknowledgment template matching the line of business.
Confirm the template version is the current published one.
Done when the correct current template is selected.
verify: Read the template id and version on the generated document.
Pass when both match the current published template.

steps.title: Confirm the merge resolves claim number, loss date, unit and contact number
sop: Generate the draft and read it end to end.
Look for unresolved merge tokens or blank placeholders.
Fix the source data on the claim rather than typing over the merge.
Done when the draft carries all four merged values with no tokens left.
verify: Search the draft text for merge token markers.
Pass when no unresolved token remains.

steps.title: State concrete next steps in the acknowledgment body
sop: State who will call the insured and by when.
List the documents the insured should gather.
Avoid a generic thank-you with no action.
Done when the body names the contact, the timescale and the documents.
verify: Read the body against those three elements.
Pass when all three are present.

steps.title: Remove any coverage, liability or settlement wording from the text
sop: Read the draft for statements about what will be paid or covered.
Delete any implied liability or settlement expectation.
Keep the message factual about process only.
Done when no coverage or settlement statement remains.
verify: Re-read the final text for coverage language.
Pass when the text carries no coverage or payment commitment.

steps.title: Send on the recorded channel preference via CRM or the Customer Self-Service Portal
sop: Read the insured contact preference on the claim.
Dispatch via CRM email, SMS or the portal message to match it.
Do not default every acknowledgment to email.
Done when the acknowledgment is sent on the recorded preference.
verify: Compare the send channel against the recorded preference.
Pass when the channels match.

steps.title: Check delivery status and raise an alternate-channel retry on bounce
sop: Run the acknowledgment delivery report for the day.
For each Failed or Bounced item raise a retry activity on the alternate channel.
Do not close a failure without a retry.
Done when every failure carries an owned retry activity.
verify: Re-run the delivery report after retries.
Pass when no failure sits without a retry activity.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every notice taken at intake requiring a reporter authority check and completeness check.
generic.In-scope period: The intake interaction, with gaps converted into open information-request activities.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, loss date, loss location, loss cause and a callable contact number.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notices logged equals notices passing validation plus notices with open information requests.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation result and authority basis retained on the claim with the check timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Notices reported on lapsed or cancelled policies flagged with a coverage question and disposition.
generic.Test population: All claims released from intake to assignment during the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: All mandatory FNOL validations pass or every gap has an open information-request activity.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete notices are still logged and assigned rather than rejected at the door.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reporter authority basis recorded and the minimum notice set present on the claim.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim validation panel and the PolicyCenter policy status record.

steps.title: Establish the reporter authority basis against PolicyCenter
sop: Confirm the reporter is named insured, additional insured, listed driver, producer of record or authorised representative.
Record which basis applies on the contact record.
For a representative capture the documented consent reference.
Done when an authority basis is recorded for the reporter.
verify: Read the authority basis on the contact record.
Pass when a controlled basis value is present.

steps.title: Check the minimum notice set is present on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Confirm policy number, loss date, loss location, loss cause and a callable number are captured.
Do not treat a mobile number with no answer as validated.
Note any element the reporter genuinely cannot supply.
Done when the five elements are present or explicitly noted as missing.
verify: Run the FNOL mandatory field validation.
Pass when validation returns no unhandled gap.

steps.title: Confirm policy status on the loss date in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Open the policy version in force on the loss date.
Confirm the status is In Force rather than cancelled, lapsed or not taken up.
Where it is not, set the coverage-question flag on the claim.
Done when policy status on the loss date is confirmed and any flag set.
verify: Filter claims released to assignment with a not-in-force policy.
Pass when each carries a coverage-question flag.

steps.title: Raise an independent contact activity where a third party reported the loss
sop: Where the reporter is not the insured create an activity to contact the insured directly.
Set the due date inside the insured contact standard.
Do not rely on the third-party account alone.
Done when an insured-contact activity exists on the claim.
verify: Check third-party reported claims for the activity.
Pass when each carries an open insured-contact activity.

steps.title: Create an information-request activity for each remaining gap
sop: Log the notice even when incomplete.
Raise one information-request activity per missing element with a named owner.
Set a due date rather than leaving the activity open ended.
Done when every gap has an owned dated activity.
verify: List gaps recorded on the claim against open activities.
Pass when each gap maps to an activity with an owner and due date.

steps.title: Sample-review released intake records against the validation standard
sop: Pull a sample of claims released to assignment.
Check authority basis, minimum notice set and any coverage-question flag.
Record the review result and feed recurring gaps into coaching.
Done when the sample is reviewed and the result recorded.
verify: Read the recorded sample result.
Pass when every sampled claim met the authority and completeness standard.

generic.Defined scope/population: All photographs, video, reports and receipts supplied at intake for the claim.
generic.In-scope period: Evidence received during intake and in the follow-up window before adjuster first contact.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document type, exposure link and access class set on every attachment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items supplied by the insured equal items attached and visible on the portal claim view.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each attachment retained with upload timestamp and the supplying party recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Zero-byte or failed uploads logged with a re-request activity and its outcome.
generic.Test population: All documents attached to claims created in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No zero-byte or untyped attachment remains on the claim.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed portal uploads raise a re-request activity owned by the Claims Adjuster.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: At least one typed indexed evidence document is linked to the claim and correct exposure.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter documents tab and the claim file document repository.

steps.title: Move intake mailbox and agent email evidence onto the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the intake mailbox thread carrying the photos or reports.
Attach each item to the claim file itself.
Do not leave evidence living only in the mailbox or email thread.
Done when every supplied item is attached to the claim.
verify: Compare the mailbox item list against the claim documents tab.
Pass when every item appears on the claim.

steps.title: Tag each attachment with its document type in the document repository
sop: Set the type as loss photo, police report, estimate, receipt or medical bill.
Do not leave the type as the generic default.
Rename obviously unhelpful file names before filing.
Done when every attachment carries a document type.
verify: Filter claim documents on untyped items.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Link each item to the correct exposure on multi-claimant claims
sop: Read which claimant the evidence relates to.
Select that exposure when attaching the document.
Do not file third-party evidence under the insured exposure.
Done when each item is linked to the right exposure.
verify: Open each exposure and read its linked documents.
Pass when no third-party item sits on the insured exposure.

steps.title: Confirm large portal uploads completed without partial or zero-byte files
sop: Open each uploaded item from the Customer Self-Service Portal and check it renders.
Check the file size is non-zero.
Re-request any item that failed to upload cleanly.
Done when every uploaded item opens and has content.
verify: List attachments with zero size on the claim.
Pass when the list is empty.

steps.title: File sensitive items to the restricted-access document class
sop: Identify medical records, identity documents and bank details among the evidence.
Set the restricted access class on those documents.
Do not leave sensitive items on the general claim document class.
Done when all sensitive items carry the restricted class.
verify: Filter claim documents on sensitive types and read the access class.
Pass when each carries the restricted class.

steps.title: Confirm the insured sees the items on their portal claim view
sop: Open the portal claim view for the insured.
Confirm each item they uploaded is listed back to them.
Raise a defect where an attached item does not surface.
Done when the portal view lists the uploaded items.
verify: Compare the portal item list against the claim documents tab.
Pass when the lists agree for insured-supplied items.

steps.title: Review the evidence set before first contact in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the claim documents tab before making first contact.
Confirm the evidence supports the reported loss and identify what is still missing.
Raise an activity for each further item needed.
Done when the evidence gap list is raised as activities.
verify: Read the open evidence activities on the claim.
Pass when each identified gap has an owned activity.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every FNOL requiring incident date, time and validated loss location capture.
generic.In-scope period: The intake interaction, including losses with separate occurrence and discovery dates.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss date, loss time of day, validated loss address and coordinates where captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims created equals claims carrying a validated loss location record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Address validation response and any GPS coordinates retained against the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Addresses resolving only to a city centroid logged with a follow-up to refine the location.
generic.Test population: All claims created in the review window across phone, portal and mobile channels.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim with a blank loss location or a location defaulted to the policy risk address.
generic.Exception handling path: GPS and address mismatches beyond tolerance are queried with the reporting party.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Loss date, time of day and a validated location are populated as discrete values.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter loss details panel and the portal submission record.

steps.title: Enter the loss date and time of day as discrete values in ClaimCenter
sop: Enter the loss date into the date field.
Enter the time of day rather than accepting a midnight default.
Ask for an approximate time where the insured is unsure and note it as approximate.
Done when both date and a real time of day are stored.
verify: Filter claims where loss time equals midnight.
Pass when no sampled claim carries a default midnight time.

steps.title: Validate the loss address through the ClaimCenter address service
sop: Type the loss address and run the address validation.
Accept a rooftop or street-level match only.
Where the match is a city centroid ask for a nearer landmark or cross street.
Done when the address resolves to a street-level or better match.
verify: Read the match level returned on the claim.
Pass when the match level is street-level or rooftop.

steps.title: Compare captured GPS coordinates against the entered address
sop: For portal and mobile FNOL read the captured coordinates.
Check the coordinates sit within a sensible distance of the entered address.
Query the reporting party where the gap is large.
Done when coordinates and address are reconciled or the gap is queried.
verify: Read the distance between coordinates and the validated address.
Pass when the distance is within tolerance or a query is logged.

steps.title: Distinguish the loss location from the policy risk address
sop: Ask explicitly where the loss happened rather than assuming the insured premises.
Enter the away-from-premises location where it differs from the risk address.
Do not copy the risk address as a shortcut.
Done when the loss location reflects where the loss actually occurred.
verify: Compare loss location against the policy risk address on sampled claims.
Pass when no claim was silently defaulted to the risk address.

steps.title: Capture both occurrence and discovery dates for delayed-discovery losses
sop: For theft or damage found later ask when it happened and when it was found.
Enter the occurrence date and the discovery date into their own fields.
Note the basis for the occurrence estimate.
Done when both dates are stored for delayed-discovery losses.
verify: Read both date fields on theft and delayed-discovery claims.
Pass when both dates are populated.

steps.title: Run the loss location completeness check before submitting the FNOL
sop: Run the FNOL validation and read any location warnings.
Resolve blanks and unvalidated addresses before submit.
Log an activity where a location cannot be refined during the call.
Done when the validation returns no unhandled location warning.
verify: Re-run the validation after correction.
Pass when no location warning remains unhandled.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every FNOL requiring the guided loss questionnaire for its line of business and loss cause.
generic.In-scope period: The intake interaction, completed before the FNOL is submitted out of Draft.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Questionnaire version, all mandatory answers and the automation-driving indicators.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Submitted FNOLs equal completed questionnaires attached to claims in the platform.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Questionnaire saved against the claim with its version and completion timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Part-completed questionnaires logged with the unanswered items and a follow-up owner.
generic.Test population: All questionnaires attached to claims submitted in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No mandatory questionnaire item left unanswered on a submitted FNOL.
generic.Exception handling path: Unanswerable items are marked not known with a reason rather than left null.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Completed questionnaire matches the line of business and loss cause on the claim.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter questionnaire panel on the claim and the portal submission payload.

steps.title: Select the questionnaire version for the line of business and loss cause
sop: Read the line of business and reported loss cause on the claim.
Pick the matching script such as auto collision, property water or liability bodily injury.
Do not run a generic script across all loss types.
Done when the matching questionnaire is open on the claim.
verify: Read the questionnaire id against the claim loss cause.
Pass when the questionnaire matches the line of business and cause.

steps.title: Work every conditional branch triggered by the answers in ClaimCenter
sop: Answer the top-level questions in order.
Complete each sub-section that the answers open.
Do not skip a branch because it looks long.
Done when no opened branch is left part-finished.
verify: Read the questionnaire completion indicator.
Pass when every opened branch shows complete.

steps.title: Set the automation-driving indicators explicitly
sop: Set injury yes or no, vehicle drivable, property habitable and third party involved.
Ask directly rather than inferring from the narrative.
Do not leave these fields null.
Done when all four indicators hold an explicit value.
verify: Filter submitted FNOLs for null indicators.
Pass when the filter returns no rows for the sample.

steps.title: Keep free text to the narrative and avoid restating structured answers
sop: Use the narrative box for the story of the loss.
Do not re-type facts already captured in structured fields.
Correct the structured field rather than contradicting it in notes.
Done when notes and structured answers do not conflict.
verify: Compare the narrative against the structured answers.
Pass when no contradiction is found.

steps.title: Save the completed questionnaire against the claim
sop: Save the questionnaire so it is attached to the claim rather than the session.
Confirm the adjuster view shows the same answer set.
Re-save if the panel shows unsaved changes.
Done when the questionnaire is visible on the claim record.
verify: Open the claim as the adjuster view and read the questionnaire.
Pass when the saved answers are visible on the claim.

steps.title: Sample-review completed questionnaires against the intake quality standard
sop: Pull a sample of submitted FNOL questionnaires.
Check script fit, branch completion and indicator population.
Record the score and feed recurring misses into coaching.
Done when the sample is scored and recorded.
verify: Read the recorded sample scores.
Pass when no sampled questionnaire has an unanswered mandatory item.

generic.Defined scope/population: Initial loss and property detail supplied by the reporting party at first notice.
generic.In-scope period: The intake interaction, before any inspection or adjuster assessment has taken place.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Damaged property description, insured estimate with source, habitability and drivability values.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Property and auto claims created equal claims carrying a damage description and estimate source.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Insured estimate retained with its capture timestamp and marked as unverified.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Refusals or unknown values logged as not supplied with a follow-up activity raised.
generic.Test population: All property and auto claims created during the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No statement of coverage or payable amount recorded during detail capture.
generic.Exception handling path: Emergency conditions found during capture route straight to the mitigation decision task.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Damaged item description and an initial loss estimate with its stated source are recorded.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter loss detail panel with the PolicyCenter property or vehicle schedule.

steps.title: Describe the damaged property in sizing detail in ClaimCenter
sop: For property record building versus contents and the rooms affected.
For auto record make, model, year, mileage and the damaged panels.
Avoid one-word descriptions such as water or crash.
Done when the description is specific enough to size the loss.
verify: Read the description against the scheduled item in PolicyCenter.
Pass when the described item can be matched to the schedule.

steps.title: Capture the insured own rough estimate and mark it unverified
sop: Ask the insured for their rough view of the loss value.
Record the figure with the source marked as insured estimate.
Do not present the figure as a reserve or an offer.
Done when the estimate is stored with its source label.
verify: Read the estimate field and its source label.
Pass when the source reads insured estimate.

steps.title: Record habitability or drivability on the claim
sop: Ask whether the property is habitable or the vehicle drivable.
Set the corresponding indicator on the claim.
Where the answer is no flag the claim for emergency mitigation.
Done when the indicator is set and any flag raised.
verify: Filter claims with a blank habitability or drivability indicator.
Pass when the sample returns no blanks.

steps.title: Note emergency repairs already done or in progress
sop: Ask what has already been done to make safe or stop further damage.
Record the works and who carried them out.
Ask the insured to retain receipts and damaged materials.
Done when the works and the retention advice are recorded.
verify: Read the claim note for the works and retention advice.
Pass when both appear on the claim.

steps.title: Flag potential other insurance or warranty cover
sop: Ask whether another policy, warranty or a third party may respond.
Record the other carrier or warranty details where given.
Set the other-insurance flag on the claim.
Done when the flag and any details are recorded.
verify: Read the other-insurance flag and details.
Pass when the flag reflects the answer given.

steps.title: Check the capture carries no coverage or payment statement
sop: Read the recorded detail for statements about what will be paid.
Remove or correct any coverage assurance made during capture.
Coach the handler where a coverage view was expressed.
Done when the record carries no coverage or payment commitment.
verify: Sample-read the intake notes on property and auto claims.
Pass when no coverage or payable amount statement is found.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every party named in the loss narrative including claimants, drivers, witnesses and third parties.
generic.In-scope period: The intake interaction, while the reporting party still has the details to hand.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Party role, reachable contact detail and third-party carrier and policy references.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Parties named in the narrative equal typed contact records created on the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Contact records retained with creation timestamp and the source of the details.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Parties whose details are unavailable logged with a follow-up activity to obtain them.
generic.Test population: All contact records created on claims in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No involved party recorded only in free-text notes without a contact record.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing third-party carrier details raise a follow-up owned by the Liability Claims Specialist.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every narrative party exists as a typed contact with a role and reachable detail.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter contacts tab and the matching CRM party records.

steps.title: Create a contact record per involved party in ClaimCenter
sop: Add each party named in the narrative as its own contact.
Set the role as claimant, driver, passenger, witness, third-party insurer, property owner or repairer.
Do not list parties only inside the narrative text.
Done when each named party has a typed contact record.
verify: Compare the narrative party list against the contacts tab.
Pass when the counts and names agree.

steps.title: Capture the other party carrier, policy and claim references
sop: Ask for the other carrier name, policy number and any claim number.
Record them on the third-party contact rather than in notes.
Explain the details support recovery of the insured outlay.
Done when the third-party carrier fields are populated or noted unavailable.
verify: Read the third-party contact carrier fields.
Pass when carrier details are present or a follow-up activity exists.

steps.title: Record injuries and treatment against each injured party
sop: Ask whether anyone was hurt and whether an ambulance attended.
Record the injury description and whether treatment was sought on the injured party record.
Do not record injury detail only against the insured.
Done when injury facts sit on the injured party record.
verify: Open injured party records and read the injury fields.
Pass when injury detail is present on each injured party.

steps.title: Record minors and vulnerable parties through a responsible adult contact
sop: Identify any minor or vulnerable party among the contacts.
Record the responsible adult as the contact route.
Do not store a direct contact number for a minor.
Done when minors are linked to a responsible adult contact.
verify: Read contact records flagged minor or vulnerable.
Pass when each routes through a responsible adult.

steps.title: Capture witness details during the intake call
sop: Ask for witness names and phone numbers while the reporter still has them.
Record each witness as a contact with the witness role.
Do not defer witness capture to the adjuster call.
Done when witness contacts exist on the claim.
verify: Read the contacts tab for witness-role records.
Pass when each witness named in the narrative has a record.

steps.title: Sync party records to CRM and review third-party completeness
sop: Confirm the party records have synced to CRM without error.
Review third-party records for missing carrier or contact detail.
Raise a follow-up activity for each gap with a due date.
Done when third-party gaps have owned follow-up activities.
verify: Read the open follow-up activities against the identified gaps.
Pass when each gap has an owned dated activity.

generic.Defined scope/population: State-mandated FNOL fields for the jurisdiction resolved from the loss location and issuing state.
generic.In-scope period: Before the claim is released from intake to assignment in the reporting day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Injury and fatality indicators, uninsured-motorist and total-loss flags, PIP fields where applicable.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims released from intake equal claims passing the state mandatory field validation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Resolved jurisdiction and field set version retained on the claim with the completion time.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: State fields left blank carry a recorded not-applicable reason on the claim.
generic.Test population: All claims released from intake in the review window grouped by resolved loss state.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim released from intake with an unresolved mandatory state field error.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolvable jurisdiction cases escalate to the Claims Analyst before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All jurisdiction-mandated FNOL fields for the resolved loss state are populated.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter regulatory field panel and the state field set configuration in the claims platform.

steps.title: Resolve the governing jurisdiction from loss location and issuing state
sop: Read the validated loss location state and the policy issuing state.
Apply the jurisdiction rule to determine the governing state.
Confirm the resolved state is visible on the claim header.
Done when the governing state is displayed on the claim.
verify: Read the resolved state field on the claim.
Pass when it is populated and consistent with the loss location rule.

steps.title: Open the state mandatory field set in the claims management platform
sop: Load the field set configured for the resolved state.
Confirm the version in use is the current published set.
Do not work from a printed or cached list.
Done when the current state field set is loaded on the claim.
verify: Read the field set version shown on the claim.
Pass when it matches the current published version.

steps.title: Complete the statistical reporting indicators on the claim
sop: Set injury and fatality indicators from the captured facts.
Set uninsured or underinsured motorist involvement where relevant.
Set the total-loss indicator where the loss is reported as a write-off.
Done when all applicable indicators hold explicit values.
verify: Run the state field validation on the claim.
Pass when no indicator error is returned.

steps.title: Populate PIP and medical-provider fields in no-fault states
sop: Identify claims in no-fault or PIP jurisdictions carrying a reported injury.
Complete the additional injury and medical-provider fields.
Raise an information request where the insured cannot supply provider detail.
Done when PIP fields are populated or an information request is open.
verify: Filter no-fault injury claims for blank PIP fields.
Pass when each blank has an open information request.

steps.title: Attach the jurisdiction acknowledgment and contact clocks to the claim
sop: Confirm the state-configured acknowledgment and contact clocks are attached.
Replace any generic default clock with the state clock where it is shorter.
Raise a configuration defect if the state clock is missing.
Done when the state clocks are shown running on the claim.
verify: Read the SLA clock panel and its source configuration.
Pass when the state-specific clocks are in force.

steps.title: Record a not-applicable reason for every blank state field
sop: List any mandated field left blank on the claim.
Record why the field does not apply.
Do not release the claim with an unexplained blank.
Done when each blank field carries a not-applicable reason.
verify: Read the reasons against blank mandated fields.
Pass when no mandated blank lacks a reason.

steps.title: Sample-review released claims against the state field standard
sop: Pull a sample of released claims per loss state.
Check field completion, clock configuration and blank reasons.
Feed recurring misses into configuration or coaching actions.
Done when the sample is reviewed and actions logged.
verify: Read the sample review record.
Pass when no sampled claim carries an unresolved mandatory state field.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every FNOL requiring a controlled cause of loss and a sequenced event narrative.
generic.In-scope period: The intake interaction, captured before the claim is passed to the assigned adjuster.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Controlled cause-of-loss value plus a narrative describing the sequence of events.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims created equal claims carrying a controlled cause value and a narrative.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Narrative stored on the claim with author and timestamp in the notes history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cause set to Other or Unknown logged with an explanatory note and a follow-up owner.
generic.Test population: All claims created in the review window across property, auto and liability lines.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim with cause of loss Other or Unknown lacking an explanatory note.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous causation is recorded factually and referred to the Claims Examiner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A controlled cause value and a sequenced narrative sufficient for adjuster first contact.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter cause-of-loss field and the claim narrative note in the document repository.

steps.title: Select the cause of loss from the controlled list in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the reported facts before choosing a cause.
Select from wind, water non-weather, fire, theft, collision or liability slip and fall.
Avoid defaulting to Other where a listed cause fits.
Done when a controlled cause value is selected.
verify: Compare the selected cause against the narrative.
Pass when the cause matches what the narrative describes.

steps.title: Record the sequence of events in order in the claim narrative
sop: Write what happened first, what failed and what damage followed.
Keep the order chronological so proximate cause can be assessed.
Do not compress the event into a single phrase.
Done when the narrative reads as an ordered sequence.
verify: Read the narrative for chronological order.
Pass when first event, failure and resulting damage are distinguishable.

steps.title: Capture coverage-relevant facts without arguing coverage
sop: Ask how long water had been leaking, whether the property was vacant and whether the vehicle was in business use.
Record the answers as facts in the narrative.
Do not draw a coverage conclusion from them.
Done when the coverage-relevant facts are recorded factually.
verify: Read the narrative for those facts and for any conclusion drawn.
Pass when facts are present and no coverage conclusion appears.

steps.title: Remove handler opinion on liability or coverage from the note
sop: Re-read the narrative for opinion words about fault or cover.
Rewrite opinion as the underlying fact reported.
Coach where opinion keeps appearing.
Done when the note carries facts only.
verify: Sample-read intake narratives for opinion language.
Pass when no sampled narrative states a liability or coverage view.

steps.title: Check the narrative supports adjuster first contact without re-interview
sop: Read the narrative as if preparing the first call.
Identify what is still unknown and raise it as an activity.
Feed back where the detail is habitually too thin.
Done when the narrative is usable or the gaps are raised.
verify: Read the open information activities on the claim.
Pass when each identified gap has an owned activity.

steps.title: Add an explanatory note where cause is Other or Unknown
sop: List claims carrying cause Other or Unknown.
Record why no listed cause applies and what is needed to resolve it.
Reclassify once the investigation resolves the cause.
Done when each Other or Unknown claim carries an explanation.
verify: Re-run the Other and Unknown list.
Pass when every entry carries an explanatory note.

generic.Defined scope/population: Losses attended by police, fire or emergency services and all theft, arson and injury claims.
generic.In-scope period: The intake interaction with follow-up activities for reports not yet issued.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Report number, issuing agency, jurisdiction and any ambulance or hospital reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Responder-attended claims equal claims carrying a report reference or a no-report value.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report reference stored on the claim with the capture timestamp and the source party.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: No-report cases recorded explicitly with the reason rather than left blank.
generic.Test population: All theft, fire, arson and injury claims created in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No theft or fire claim without a report reference or an open activity to obtain one.
generic.Exception handling path: Reports not yet issued raise a report-ordering activity with a chase date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report number and issuing agency recorded, or an explicit no-report-filed value set.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter responder reference fields and the claim file document repository.

steps.title: Ask whether emergency services attended and record the answer
sop: Ask whether police, fire or ambulance attended the loss.
Record the attending services on the claim.
Do not assume attendance from the loss type.
Done when attendance is recorded as yes or no.
verify: Read the attendance field on the claim.
Pass when it holds an explicit value.

steps.title: Capture the report number with the issuing agency in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the police or fire report number exactly as given.
Record the issuing agency name and its jurisdiction alongside it.
Do not store the number without the agency, since it is then not orderable.
Done when number, agency and jurisdiction are stored together.
verify: Read the three fields on the claim.
Pass when all three are populated.

steps.title: Record an explicit no-report-filed value with the reason
sop: Where no report exists set the no-report value rather than leaving blank.
Record why no report was filed.
Do not close the question with silence.
Done when the no-report value and reason are stored.
verify: Filter claims with blank responder fields.
Pass when no claim is blank without a no-report value.

steps.title: Raise a report-ordering activity for theft, arson and injury losses
sop: Where the report is not yet available raise a report-ordering activity.
Set an owner and a chase date on the activity.
Include the agency and jurisdiction so the order can be placed.
Done when the activity exists with owner, date and agency detail.
verify: Read the open activities on theft and fire claims.
Pass when each lacking a reference carries an ordering activity.

steps.title: Record the ambulance or hospital reference for injury losses
sop: Ask for the ambulance service and hospital where an injury was treated.
Record the reference against the injured party.
Note where the insured cannot supply it.
Done when the medical reference is captured or noted unavailable.
verify: Open the injured party record and read the medical reference.
Pass when the reference is present or explicitly noted unavailable.

steps.title: Confirm references are on the claim so SIU and ordering can proceed
sop: Open the claim and read the responder reference fields.
Confirm the detail is sufficient to order the report without contacting the insured again.
Raise a gap activity where it is not.
Done when the reference set supports ordering unaided.
verify: Attempt an order using only the claim-stored detail.
Pass when the order can be placed without a call back.

generic.Defined scope/population: All intake records completed in the review window and awaiting release to assignment.
generic.In-scope period: Between FNOL submission and claim assignment on the same working day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss date, loss location, party count, cause, coverage and the recorded quality score.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Party count on the claim reconciles to the contact records created for the loss.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation activity retained with reviewer, score and completion timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every gap raised as a named follow-up activity with a due date and outcome.
generic.Test population: Intake records reviewed against the FNOL quality scorecard in the window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No inconsistency between injury or third-party indicators and the contacts on the claim.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved inconsistencies escalate to the Claims Coordinator before assignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation activity completed and every gap carries an owned follow-up activity.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter validation activity and the quality scorecard record in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Cross-check structured fields against the narrative in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the narrative then compare loss date, loss location and party count.
Query any field that contradicts the story told.
Record the comparison result on the validation activity.
Done when the three fields are confirmed consistent or queried.
verify: Read the validation activity for the comparison result.
