Pass when each field is marked consistent or queried.

steps.title: Check the loss cause is consistent with the selected coverage and line
sop: Compare the cause of loss against the coverage and line of business chosen.
Query mismatches before the claim is assigned.
Correct the coverage rather than the narrative where the notice was miskeyed.
Done when cause, coverage and line agree or a query is raised.
verify: Read the coverage against the cause on sampled claims.
Pass when no unqueried mismatch remains.

steps.title: Reconcile injury and third-party indicators with the contact records
sop: Read the injury and third-party indicators on the claim.
Compare them against the contacts actually created.
Correct whichever side is wrong rather than ignoring the gap.
Done when indicators and contacts agree.
verify: Run the indicator versus contact consistency check.
Pass when the check returns no mismatch.

steps.title: Score the record against the FNOL quality scorecard
sop: Apply the published scorecard criteria to the intake record.
Log the score so intake quality is trended rather than fixed silently.
Note the specific criteria that failed.
Done when the score and failed criteria are logged.
verify: Read the logged score for the record.
Pass when a score and any failed criteria are recorded.

steps.title: Raise each remaining gap as an owned follow-up activity
sop: Create one activity per gap in the workflow tool.
Assign a named handler and a due date to each.
Do not record gaps as a general note.
Done when every gap has an owned dated activity.
verify: Compare the gap list against open activities.
Pass when each gap maps to an activity with owner and due date.

steps.title: Complete the intake validation activity before release to assignment
sop: Confirm all checks are worked and gaps are owned.
Complete the validation activity on the claim.
Escalate to the Claims Coordinator where an inconsistency is unresolved.
Done when the validation activity is closed complete.
verify: Read the validation activity status on released claims.
Pass when every released claim carries a completed validation.

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims awaiting assignment where the routing rule set must determine the handler.
generic.In-scope period: From claim creation to the 24-hour assignment standard for the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Line of business, loss state, complexity tier and the fired rule recorded on the assignment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims created equals claims assigned by rule plus claims in the assignment exception queue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Fired rule id and assignment timestamp retained on the claim assignment history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Manual overrides logged with the reason and made visible to the supervisor.
generic.Test population: All assignments made in the review window across lines and territories.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim on group-only assignment past the 24-hour assignment standard.
generic.Exception handling path: Rule failures route to the assignment exception queue owned by the Claims Coordinator.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assignment shows the rule that fired and a named licensed handler for the jurisdiction.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter assignment history and the rule execution log in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Confirm line of business, loss state and complexity tier are set on the claim
sop: Read the three routing inputs on the claim before running the rule.
Correct any missing or defaulted value.
Do not run assignment on incomplete inputs.
Done when all three inputs hold valid values.
verify: Read the three fields on the claim.
Pass when none is blank or defaulted.

steps.title: Run the assignment rule in the workflow tool and record the fired rule
sop: Execute the assignment rule set against the claim.
Record the rule id that fired on the assignment history.
Do not assign by hand before the rule has run.
Done when a fired rule id is recorded on the claim.
verify: Read the assignment history for a rule id.
Pass when a rule id is present on the assignment.

steps.title: Check the selected handler licence for the loss jurisdiction
sop: Open the handler licence record for the loss state.
Confirm the licence is active and unexpired on the assignment date.
Reject the assignment where it is not.
Done when the handler licence is confirmed active for the state.
verify: Sample assignments and read licence status.
Pass when every assigned handler is licensed for the loss state.

steps.title: Confirm the handler authority covers the assigned complexity tier
sop: Compare the claim tier against the handler authority level.
Reroute claims above the senior-adjuster threshold to a senior handler.
Do not leave a high-tier claim on a general handler.
Done when handler authority meets or exceeds the claim tier.
verify: Compare tier against authority on sampled assignments.
Pass when authority meets the tier on each.

steps.title: Record the reason for any manual override of the rule outcome
sop: Where the rule outcome is overridden state what the rule proposed.
Record the chosen handler and the reason for the change.
Make the override visible on the supervisor override view.
Done when the override carries a recorded reason.
verify: Read the override list for the day.
Pass when every override carries a reason and is visible to the supervisor.

steps.title: Clear group-only assignments before the 24-hour standard expires
sop: Run the group-only assignment view sorted by claim age.
Name an individual handler on each item.
Escalate capacity shortfalls rather than letting claims age.
Done when no claim remains group-only past 24 hours.
verify: Re-run the group-only view.
Pass when it returns no claim older than 24 hours.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims that may warrant catastrophe, mass-tort or major-account flags at triage.
generic.In-scope period: The triage window and any later point where new facts change the flag position.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Flag type, trigger reason and the event or account reference behind the flag.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Flagged claim counts reconcile to the event, account and aggregation reporting views.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Flag set and removal actions retained in the claim audit entry with user and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Flags applied in error removed with a stated reason rather than silently deleted.
generic.Test population: All claims carrying or eligible for a severity flag in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No flag added or removed without an accompanying audit entry.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed flags escalate to the Catastrophe & Exposure Manager for a ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Applicable severity flags are set with a recorded trigger reason on the claim.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter flag panel and the claim audit history in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Check the loss against declared CAT events before setting the CAT flag
sop: Compare loss date, geography and peril against declared events.
Set the CAT flag only where all three match.
Record the event reference with the flag.
Done when the CAT flag is set with its event reference or deliberately not set.
verify: Read the event reference against the flag.
Pass when every CAT flag names a declared event.

steps.title: Set the major-account flag from the account tier in the claims platform
sop: Read the account tier carried on the policy.
Set the major-account flag for named large or strategic accounts.
Record the account reference with the flag.
Done when the major-account flag reflects the account tier.
verify: Compare the flag against the account tier on sampled claims.
Pass when the flag matches the tier.

steps.title: Apply the mass-tort or aggregation flag for shared-cause losses
sop: Check whether the loss shares a defect, product or event with other open claims.
Set the aggregation flag and record the linking reference.
Do not flag on similarity of loss type alone.
Done when the aggregation flag carries a linking reference.
verify: Read the linking reference on aggregation-flagged claims.
Pass when each names the shared cause or event.

steps.title: Record the trigger reason for each flag on the claim
sop: Write the facts that triggered each flag in the flag reason field.
State how the flag changes reserving or reporting treatment.
Do not rely on the flag name alone.
Done when every flag carries a written trigger reason.
verify: Read the reason field against each set flag.
Pass when no flag is missing its reason.

steps.title: Remove flags applied in error with a stated reason
sop: Review flags challenged during file review.
Remove any that do not meet the criteria and state why.
Do not simply clear the flag without an audit note.
Done when removals carry a recorded reason.
verify: Read the audit history for flag removals.
Pass when every removal carries a reason entry.

steps.title: Reconcile flagged claims against event and aggregate reporting
sop: Compare flagged claim counts against the event and aggregation reporting views.
Investigate claims that appear in one view and not the other.
Correct the flag or the reporting configuration as appropriate.
Done when the counts reconcile or variances are explained.
verify: Re-run the reconciliation after correction.
Pass when counts agree or each variance is explained.

generic.Defined scope/population: All newly notified claims requiring an initial severity tier before assignment.
generic.In-scope period: The triage window running from claim creation to assignment of the handling track.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Severity tier, triage criteria scores, estimated exposure and the rationale note.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims triaged equals claims carrying a severity tier and a triage rationale note.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Triage note retained with author, timestamp and the benchmark table version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Tier overrides against the benchmark logged with approval and reason.
generic.Test population: All claims triaged in the review window across lines of business.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim above the large-loss threshold carries a low tier without documented approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Tier disputes escalate to the Claims Director for a recorded decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A severity tier set with a triage rationale note referencing the criteria used.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter triage panel and the reserve benchmark table in the claims platform.

steps.title: Score the claim against the triage criteria in ClaimCenter
sop: Score injury severity, claimant count, estimated damage, coverage question and litigation likelihood.
Use the captured intake facts rather than assumption.
Record each score on the triage panel.
Done when all five criteria carry scores.
verify: Read the triage panel scores.
Pass when no criterion is left unscored.

steps.title: Compare estimated exposure against the reserve benchmark table
sop: Open the benchmark table for the line of business.
Compare the estimated exposure against the tier bands.
Note the benchmark version used.
Done when the benchmark band for the exposure is identified.
verify: Read the identified band against the estimate.
Pass when the band matches the estimate range.

steps.title: Escalate the tier for coverage questions, fatality, attorney or commercial third party
sop: Check for a coverage question, a fatality, an involved attorney or a commercial third party.
Raise the tier where any of these is present regardless of damage estimate.
Record which trigger drove the escalation.
Done when escalation triggers are applied and recorded.
verify: Read the recorded trigger on escalated claims.
Pass when each escalation names its trigger.

steps.title: Set the severity tier and confirm the handling track it drives
sop: Set the tier on the claim.
Confirm the handling track and adjuster authority level update accordingly.
Correct a mismatch rather than working around it.
Done when tier, track and authority level are aligned.
verify: Read the track and authority against the tier.
Pass when all three are consistent.

steps.title: Write the triage rationale note on the claim
sop: State the criteria scores, the benchmark used and why the tier was chosen.
Write it as a typed triage note rather than a general file note.
Include what is still unknown at triage.
Done when the rationale note is saved on the claim.
verify: Read the note for criteria, benchmark and reasoning.
Pass when all three elements are present.

steps.title: Review large-loss claims carrying a low tier
sop: Run the report of claims above the large-loss threshold by tier.
Review any carrying a low tier and either correct it or approve it in writing.
Record the approval on the claim.
Done when every such claim is corrected or approved.
verify: Re-run the report after review.
Pass when no low-tier large loss lacks documented approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: All triaged claims awaiting assignment to a named licensed adjuster.
generic.In-scope period: Within 24 hours of the notice, with no claim held overnight in a group queue.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Named adjuster, licence state and expiry, line authority and settlement authority level.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Triaged claims equal claims with a named adjuster plus documented assignment exceptions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment record retained with timestamp, assigning user and licence check result.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assignments blocked by licence or capacity logged with the interim owner and resolution.
generic.Test population: All assignments completed in the review window across loss jurisdictions.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim assigned to a handler without an active licence in the loss jurisdiction.
generic.Exception handling path: Licence or capacity blocks escalate to the Claims Director for reallocation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A named adjuster with active licence and adequate authority assigned within 24 hours.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter assignment record and the adjuster licence register in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Check adjuster licence status for the loss state in the workflow tool
sop: Open the licence register for the candidate adjuster.
Confirm the licence for the loss state is active and unexpired today.
Accept an emergency CAT licence only where the event permits it.
Done when the licence is confirmed valid for the loss state.
verify: Read the licence expiry against the assignment date.
Pass when the licence is unexpired on that date.

steps.title: Confirm line-of-business authority covers the claim type
sop: Compare the claim type against the adjuster authorised lines.
Confirm property, auto physical damage, bodily injury or commercial as applicable.
Do not assign outside the authorised lines.
Done when the claim type sits inside the adjuster authorised lines.
verify: Read the authorised lines against the claim type.
Pass when the claim type is covered.

steps.title: Check the settlement authority ladder against the reserve estimate
sop: Read the estimated reserve for the claim.
Compare it against the adjuster settlement authority limit.
Route upward where the estimate exceeds the limit.
Done when the estimate sits inside the assigned handler authority.
verify: Compare estimate against authority on sampled assignments.
Pass when no estimate exceeds the handler limit.

steps.title: Check workload and absence status before naming the handler
sop: Read current open inventory and absence status for the candidate.
Avoid assigning to a handler on leave or over capacity.
Choose an alternative licensed handler where needed.
Done when the named handler is available and within capacity.
verify: Read absence status for assigned handlers.
Pass when no claim was assigned to a handler on leave.

steps.title: Assign the claim to the named adjuster in ClaimCenter
sop: Set the named adjuster on the claim rather than a group.
Confirm the assignment activity is raised for the handler.
Record the assignment timestamp.
Done when the claim carries a named adjuster and an assignment activity.
verify: Read the assignment record on the claim.
Pass when a named handler and timestamp are present.

steps.title: Clear claims approaching the 24-hour assignment standard
sop: Run the unassigned and group-queue view sorted by age.
Reallocate anything approaching 24 hours.
Escalate licensing gaps that block assignment.
Done when no claim exceeds the 24-hour standard unassigned.
verify: Re-run the ageing view at end of day.
Pass when no claim older than 24 hours is unassigned.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every newly assigned claim requiring a handling-instruction package for the adjuster.
generic.In-scope period: From assignment until the adjuster acknowledges the assignment activity.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage position, contact SLA, diary cadence, reserve expectation and escalation contact.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims assigned equals packages attached plus documented package exceptions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Package attached to the claim with its guideline version and generation timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unacknowledged assignments logged with chase action and the final acknowledgment date.
generic.Test population: All assignments made in the review window carrying a handling-instruction package.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No assignment activity left unacknowledged by the assigned handler.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or superseded packages escalate to the Claims Director for reissue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A current-version package attached with its acknowledgment activity complete.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter documents tab and the handling guideline library in the document repository.

steps.title: Generate the handling-instruction package on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Trigger package generation from the assignment activity.
Confirm it covers coverage position to date, contact SLA, diary cadence and reserve expectation.
Do not send instructions by email in place of the package.
Done when the package is attached to the claim.
verify: Read the package on the claim documents tab.
Pass when all four content areas are present.

steps.title: Check the package version against the published handling guideline
sop: Read the guideline version stamped on the package.
Compare it with the current published version in the document repository.
Regenerate where a superseded version was attached.
Done when the attached package is the current version.
verify: Compare the package version against the library.
Pass when the versions match.

steps.title: Add account or programme special instructions where applicable
sop: Check whether large-account service standards, TPA protocols or litigation rules apply.
Attach the applicable special instruction set to the package.
Do not rely on the handler knowing the account rules.
Done when applicable special instructions are attached.
verify: Read the package for account or programme instructions.
Pass when applicable instructions are present on those claims.

steps.title: Confirm the package names the escalation contact and authority limits
sop: Read the escalation section of the package.
Confirm it names a person or role and states the authority limits for this claim.
Correct a generic placeholder.
Done when escalation contact and limits are named.
verify: Read the escalation section.
Pass when a named contact and stated limits appear.

steps.title: Confirm the assigned adjuster acknowledged the assignment activity
sop: Open the assignment activity and read its status.
Chase the handler where it remains open past the acknowledgment window.
Do not treat package generation alone as acknowledgment.
Done when the acknowledgment activity is complete.
verify: Run the unacknowledged assignment view.
Pass when the view holds no item for the review window.

steps.title: Review package issuance and acknowledgment across the day assignments
sop: Run the daily assignment report with package and acknowledgment status.
Chase missing packages and unacknowledged assignments.
Record the review and any systemic gap for configuration fix.
Done when the report shows no missing package or acknowledgment.
verify: Re-run the report after chasing.
Pass when every assignment carries a package and an acknowledgment.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims where the property may be unsafe or uninhabitable or the vehicle undrivable.
generic.In-scope period: The same working day as the mitigation question is raised at intake or first contact.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Security, habitability and displacement answers plus the recorded mitigation decision.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims flagged uninhabitable or undrivable equal claims carrying a mitigation decision.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Decision and vendor dispatch retained on the claim with time and authorised duration.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Not-required decisions recorded with a reason rather than left unanswered.
generic.Test population: All property and auto claims raised in the review window with damage reported.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim flagged uninhabitable or undrivable without a mitigation or accommodation decision.
generic.Exception handling path: Vendor unavailability escalates to the Vendor Coordinator for an alternate supplier.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A recorded mitigation decision with a vendor assignment where services were required.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter mitigation panel and the vendor dispatch record in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Ask whether the property is secure, dry and habitable and record the answers
sop: Ask directly about security, water ingress, habitability and displacement.
Record each answer on the claim mitigation panel.
Do not infer the answers from the damage description.
Done when all four answers are recorded.
verify: Read the mitigation panel answers.
Pass when none is blank.

steps.title: Dispatch board-up, extraction or tarping from the approved vendor network
sop: Select the emergency service required from the approved network.
Raise the dispatch the same working day the need is identified.
Record the vendor, scope and target attendance time.
Done when the vendor dispatch is raised on the claim.
verify: Read the dispatch record for vendor and scope.
Pass when dispatch was raised the same working day.

steps.title: Authorise emergency accommodation or a hire vehicle where needed
sop: Where the insured cannot occupy the property or drive, authorise accommodation or hire.
Record the authorised duration and rate on the claim.
Do not authorise open ended arrangements.
Done when the authorisation with duration and rate is recorded.
verify: Read the authorisation fields on the claim.
Pass when duration and rate are both stated.

steps.title: Advise the insured to mitigate further damage and retain receipts
sop: Tell the insured to prevent further damage and keep damaged items.
Ask them to retain all receipts for emergency works.
Note the advice given on the claim.
Done when the advice is recorded on the claim.
verify: Read the claim note for the mitigation advice.
Pass when the advice is recorded.

steps.title: Record an explicit not-required decision where mitigation is unnecessary
sop: Where no emergency service is needed record the not-required decision.
State the reason such as property secure and dry.
Do not leave the mitigation question unanswered.
Done when a not-required decision with reason is stored.
verify: Filter claims with a blank mitigation decision.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Review emergency dispatches and habitability flags for the day
sop: Run the report of claims flagged uninhabitable or undrivable.
Confirm each carries a mitigation or accommodation decision.
Chase any missing decision with the assigned adjuster.
Done when every flagged claim carries a decision.
verify: Re-run the report after chasing.
Pass when no flagged claim lacks a decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every claim that has been triaged and requires its decision documented on the file.
generic.In-scope period: Within 24 hours of the triage action being taken.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Note category Triage decision, severity tier, driving criteria and handling track.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims triaged equals claims carrying a typed triage decision note.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Triage note retained with author and timestamp in the claim notes history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deviations from the rule outcome recorded with the approver named.
generic.Test population: All claims triaged in the review window across handling tracks.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No triage decision recorded only outside the claim system.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or unclear notes are returned to the Claims Examiner for rework.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A typed triage decision note exists within 24 hours of the triage action.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter notes tab with the triage note filed in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Create the note using the Triage decision category in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the notes panel and select the Triage decision category.
Do not file the decision as a generic file note.
Confirm the category is retained on save.
Done when the note is saved under the Triage decision category.
verify: Filter claim notes by category.
Pass when the triage note appears under Triage decision.

steps.title: State the severity tier and the criteria that drove it
sop: Write the tier chosen in the note.
List the criteria and scores that drove the tier.
Avoid a bare statement of the tier with no reasoning.
Done when tier and driving criteria appear in the note.
verify: Read the note for tier and criteria.
Pass when both are stated.

steps.title: State the handling track the claim was routed to
sop: Record the track such as fast-track, standard, complex or litigation.
Confirm the stated track matches the routing applied on the claim.
Correct a mismatch before saving.
Done when the note names the track applied.
verify: Compare the note track against the claim routing.
Pass when the two agree.

steps.title: Document any deviation from the rule-based outcome and its approver
sop: Where the rule outcome was not followed state what it proposed.
Record what was chosen instead and who approved it.
Do not leave the deviation implied.
Done when deviations carry a stated approver and reason.
verify: Read deviation notes for an approver name.
Pass when every deviation names its approver.

steps.title: Record what remains unknown at triage
sop: List the facts still outstanding that could change the tier.
Raise an activity for each where it needs chasing.
Keep the language plain for a later reviewer.
Done when the unknowns are stated in the note.
verify: Read the note for the unknowns section.
Pass when outstanding facts are listed.

steps.title: Sample-review triage notes against the documentation standard
sop: Pull a sample of triaged claims from the review window.
Check note category, tier, criteria, track and readability.
Return unclear notes to the examiner for rework.
Done when the sample is reviewed and rework raised.
verify: Read the sample review record.
Pass when every sampled claim carries a compliant triage note within 24 hours.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every insured whose claim has been assigned to a named handler.
generic.In-scope period: Within 24 hours of the assignment being made on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Handler name, direct phone, email, working hours and the next-step timescale.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assignments made equal logged handler notifications plus recorded contact attempts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification logged on the claim with channel and timestamp of each attempt.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unreached insureds logged with the attempt and a diarised alternate-channel retry.
generic.Test population: All claims assigned during the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No assigned claim older than 24 hours with zero recorded contact attempts.
generic.Exception handling path: Repeated no-contact escalates to the Claims Processor for alternate tracing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Handler details communicated with next steps and visible on the portal claim view.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter contact log and the CRM outbound notification record.

steps.title: Communicate handler name, direct number, email and hours to the insured
sop: Give the handler name, direct phone, email and working hours.
Confirm the insured has captured the details.
Do not give a general call-centre number in place of the direct line.
Done when all four details have been communicated.
verify: Read the contact log entry for the four details.
Pass when all four appear in the logged notification.

steps.title: State what happens next and the expected timescale
sop: Explain the next step and when the substantive contact will happen.
Set a realistic timescale rather than a vague soon.
Record the timescale given on the claim.
Done when next step and timescale are recorded.
verify: Read the contact log for the stated timescale.
Pass when a specific timescale is recorded.

steps.title: Log each contact attempt in ClaimCenter
sop: Record every attempt with date, time and channel.
Log unsuccessful attempts as well as successful ones.
Do not leave an attempt unrecorded because nobody answered.
Done when every attempt is logged.
verify: Count logged attempts against calls made.
Pass when each attempt has a log entry.

steps.title: Diarise an alternate-channel retry where the insured was not reached
sop: Raise a retry activity on a different channel for unreached insureds.
Set the due date inside the contact standard.
Do not close the notification as complete without contact or a retry.
Done when a retry activity exists for each unreached insured.
verify: Read open retry activities against unreached claims.
Pass when each unreached claim carries a retry.

steps.title: Copy the agent or broker of record where the service model requires it
sop: Check the account service model on the policy.
Copy the producer of record on the handler notification where required.
Record that the producer was copied.
Done when the producer copy is sent and recorded where required.
verify: Read the notification record for the producer copy.
Pass when required claims show the producer copied.

steps.title: Confirm handler details appear on the portal claim view
sop: Open the insured portal claim view.
Confirm the handler name and contact details are displayed.
Raise a defect where the details do not surface.
Done when the portal shows the assigned handler details.
verify: Compare the portal display against the claim assignment.
Pass when the handler details are visible to the insured.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every FNOL requiring early fraud red-flag screening and watchlist checks.
generic.In-scope period: At first notice, with SIU referral raised within 48 hours of an indicator being seen.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Red-flag checklist outcome, automated fraud score and sanctions screening result.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: FNOLs created equal FNOLs with a returned fraud score and a completed checklist.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Screening result retained with engine version, score and screening timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Triggered red flags logged with the SIU referral reference and its outcome.
generic.Test population: All FNOLs screened in the review window across lines of business.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim with triggered red flags lacking an SIU referral beyond 48 hours.
generic.Exception handling path: Sanctions or watchlist hits escalate before any payment step is taken.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A completed screening result with the red-flag checklist outcome on the claim.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter screening panel and the FRISS Fraud Detection case record.

steps.title: Run the documented red-flag checklist against the FNOL in ClaimCenter
sop: Check loss shortly after inception or a coverage increase.
Check missing police report on a theft, prior similar claims and reluctance to give detail.
Check pressure for a fast cash settlement.
Record the outcome per indicator.
Done when every checklist indicator carries an outcome.
verify: Read the checklist outcomes on the claim.
Pass when no indicator is left unanswered.

steps.title: Confirm the FRISS fraud score has returned and been reviewed
sop: Open the FRISS case for the claim and read the returned score.
Do not advance the claim before scoring completes.
Record that the score was reviewed and by whom.
Done when the score is returned and its review is recorded.
verify: Read the score and review stamp on the claim.
Pass when both are present before the claim advanced.

steps.title: Run sanctions and watchlist screening on the named parties
sop: Screen all named parties at first notice.
Read each hit rather than dismissing partial name matches.
Escalate any hit before any payment step is taken.
Done when screening has run for every named party.
verify: Read the screening record per party.
Pass when every named party carries a screening result.

steps.title: Raise the SIU referral within 48 hours citing the specific indicators
sop: Where indicators are present raise the referral in FRISS and on the claim.
Cite the specific indicators and the facts behind each.
Avoid a generic statement of suspicion.
Done when the referral exists citing named indicators.
verify: Read the referral text and its raise date.
Pass when it names indicators and was raised within 48 hours.

steps.title: Continue normal handling and avoid telling the insured about the review
sop: Handle the claim within normal service standards during screening.
Do not disclose the fraud review to the insured or any party.
Hold payments only where the handling guideline permits.
Done when handling continues normally with no disclosure made.
verify: Read the claim contact log for any disclosure of the review.
Pass when no disclosure appears.

steps.title: Review referral quality and write back the outcome in FRISS
sop: Review new referrals for cited indicators and attached evidence.
Return referrals that lack specificity for rework.
Write the investigation outcome back to the claim on closure.
Done when each referral is accepted or returned and outcomes are written back.
verify: Run the open referral list with outcomes.
Pass when no closed investigation lacks a recorded outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every assigned claim requiring contact, coverage and reserve review diaries.
generic.In-scope period: From assignment through the 30, 60 and 90-day reserve review cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Diary type, due date, owner and the severity tier driving the cadence.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open claims equal claims carrying at least one future-dated diary entry.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Diary entries retained with creation timestamp and reassignment history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Diaries orphaned by handler change logged and reassigned to the new owner.
generic.Test population: All claims assigned in the review window with diaries created.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No open claim without a future-dated diary entry.
generic.Exception handling path: Missed or orphaned diaries escalate to the Claims Coordinator for reassignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Contact, coverage and 30/60/90-day reserve diaries exist with a named owner.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter diary panel and the diary queue in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Set the first contact diary inside the 24-hour contact standard
sop: Create the first contact diary on assignment.
Date it inside the 24-hour insured contact standard.
Do not push it to the end of the week.
Done when the contact diary is dated inside 24 hours.
verify: Read the contact diary due date against the assignment time.
Pass when it falls inside 24 hours.

steps.title: Set the coverage confirmation diary within the post-assignment standard
sop: Create the coverage confirmation diary.
Date it inside the 24-hour post-assignment coverage standard.
Link it to the coverage verification activity.
Done when the coverage diary exists inside the standard.
verify: Read the coverage diary due date.
Pass when it falls inside the coverage standard.

steps.title: Create 30, 60 and 90-day reserve review diaries
sop: Create reserve review diaries at 30, 60 and 90 days.
Align them with the published reserve review cadence.
Do not rely on a single ad hoc reminder.
Done when all three reserve diaries exist.
verify: Read the diary list for the three review dates.
Pass when all three are present.

steps.title: Tighten the cadence to match the severity tier
sop: Read the severity tier on the claim.
Shorten diary intervals for large-loss and litigated claims.
Record why the cadence differs from the default.
Done when the cadence matches the tier.
verify: Compare diary intervals against the tier cadence table.
Pass when intervals match the tier.

steps.title: Set the assigned handler as diary owner in ClaimCenter
sop: Set the diary owner to the assigned handler rather than a group.
Confirm reassignment on handler change carries diaries across.
Raise a defect where diaries orphan on reassignment.
Done when every diary carries a named owner.
verify: Filter diaries with no named owner.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Review open claims for missing future-dated diaries
sop: Run the open claim view filtered on claims with no future diary.
Chase the assigned handler to set the missing diaries.
Escalate repeat offenders to the coordinator.
Done when the no-diary view is cleared.
verify: Re-run the no-diary view.
Pass when it returns no open claims.

generic.Defined scope/population: All newly assigned claims requiring initial indemnity and expense reserves per exposure.
generic.In-scope period: Within 72 hours of the notice being received.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Indemnity reserve, expense reserve, exposure link, worksheet reference and rationale note.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exposures open on the claim equal exposures carrying a posted initial reserve.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reserve postings retained with worksheet version, poster and posting timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reserves above authority logged with the manager approval reference before posting.
generic.Test population: All reserves posted on claims notified in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No reserve above the authority threshold posted without recorded manager approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Reserves exceeding handler authority route to the Claims Director for approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Indemnity and expense reserves posted per exposure within 72 hours with a rationale note.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter financials tab and the reserve worksheet in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Open the reserve worksheet for the severity tier and line of business
sop: Select the worksheet matching the tier and line.
Read the benchmark ranges that apply.
Do not post a round-number placeholder in place of the worksheet result.
Done when the applicable worksheet is open and its version noted.
verify: Read the worksheet reference recorded with the posting.
Pass when a worksheet version is recorded.

steps.title: Post the initial indemnity reserve per exposure in ClaimCenter
sop: Post indemnity against each exposure rather than a single claim-level lump.
Use the worksheet output for each exposure.
Confirm the posting saves without a validation error.
Done when every open exposure carries an indemnity reserve.
verify: Read the financials tab per exposure.
Pass when no open exposure has a zero indemnity reserve.

steps.title: Post expense reserves separately from indemnity
sop: Estimate adjuster, expert and legal costs for the claim.
Post them to the expense reserve category.
Do not fold expense into the indemnity figure.
Done when expense reserves are posted separately.
verify: Read the expense category balance.
Pass when an expense reserve is posted and separate from indemnity.

steps.title: Write the reserve rationale note citing the benchmark used
sop: State the estimate basis and the benchmark or worksheet used.
Note the assumptions and what could move the figure.
File it against the claim financial notes.
Done when the rationale note is saved.
verify: Read the rationale note for the benchmark reference.
Pass when the benchmark or estimate source is cited.

steps.title: Capture manager approval where reserve exceeds authority or the change threshold
sop: Compare the reserve against handler authority and the 25K change threshold.
Obtain and record manager approval before posting where either is exceeded.
Do not post first and seek approval afterwards.
Done when approval is recorded before the posting.
verify: Compare approval timestamps against posting timestamps.
Pass when approval precedes each above-threshold posting.

steps.title: Review reserve postings against the 72-hour standard
sop: Run the report of claims notified more than 72 hours ago with no reserve.
Chase the assigned handler on each.
Review above-threshold postings for recorded approval.
Done when the no-reserve list is cleared and approvals verified.
verify: Re-run the report after chasing.
Pass when no claim past 72 hours lacks a posted reserve.

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims passing through workflow routing to a handling track after intake.
generic.In-scope period: The routing run for claims created since the previous run in the working day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rule set version, fired rule id, resulting handling track and specialty trigger flags.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims entering routing equal claims on a track plus claims in the exception queue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Routing result retained with rule set version and execution timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched claims land in the routing exception queue with a named owner.
generic.Test population: All claims routed in the review window across handling tracks.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim in the routing exception queue without an assigned owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmatched or contested routings escalate to the Claims Director for placement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The fired rule and resulting handling track are recorded on the claim.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter workflow history and the rule execution log in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Confirm the routing rule set version in force in the workflow tool
sop: Read the active rule set version before the run.
Compare it with the current published version.
Halt and escalate where a superseded set is active.
Done when the active version is confirmed current.
verify: Read the version stamped on the routing results.
Pass when it matches the published version.

steps.title: Run routing and record the fired rule and resulting track
sop: Execute the routing run against the claim batch.
Record the fired rule id and resulting track on each claim.
Do not move claims by hand before the rule has run.
Done when each routed claim carries a rule id and track.
verify: Read the workflow history on sampled claims.
Pass when rule id and track are both recorded.

steps.title: Check fast-track eligibility criteria before a claim is fast-tracked
sop: Confirm no injury, a single party, damage under the threshold and no coverage question.
Remove the claim from fast-track where any criterion fails.
Record the eligibility check result.
Done when every fast-tracked claim satisfies all four criteria.
verify: Sample fast-track claims against the four criteria.
Pass when each satisfies all four.

steps.title: Confirm specialty triggers redirect before a generalist queue
sop: Check bodily injury, commercial liability, subrogation potential and total loss flags.
Confirm flagged claims routed to the specialty track.
Reroute any that landed on a generalist queue.
Done when no flagged claim sits on a generalist track.
verify: Filter flagged claims by assigned track.
Pass when each sits on its specialty track.

steps.title: Assign an owner to every claim in the routing exception queue
sop: Open the routing exception queue after the run.
Assign a named owner to each unmatched claim.
Record the rule gap that caused the exception.
Done when every exception has an owner and a recorded cause.
verify: Read the exception queue for unassigned items.
Pass when no exception item is unassigned.

steps.title: Review routing outcomes and rule gaps for the day
sop: Review the distribution of claims across handling tracks.
Investigate spikes on the exception queue or the default group.
Raise configuration changes for recurring rule gaps.
Done when the review is recorded and any change request raised.
verify: Read the recorded review and change requests.
Pass when each recurring gap has a raised change request.

generic.Defined scope/population: All CAT-tagged claims for the declared event requiring assignment to the CAT adjuster roster.
generic.In-scope period: The event assignment cycle from roster activation to event stand-down.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assigned CAT adjuster, firm, licence status, CAT supervisor and geographic cluster.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: CAT claims for the event equal claims assigned to rostered CAT adjusters.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment record retained with roster version, licence check and assignment timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims assigned outside the roster logged and reassigned with a reason.
generic.Test population: All CAT claims assigned during the event in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No CAT claim assigned to a handler outside the activated CAT roster.
generic.Exception handling path: Roster capacity shortfalls escalate to the Claims Director for additional call-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: CAT claims assigned to a rostered CAT adjuster with a named CAT supervisor.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter assignment record and the CAT roster in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Open the activated CAT adjuster roster for the event in the workflow tool
sop: Load the roster activated for this specific event.
Include approved independent adjuster firms on the roster.
Exclude anyone not called off for the event.
Done when the activated roster is loaded and its version noted.
verify: Read the roster version used on assignments.
Pass when it matches the activated event roster.

steps.title: Verify state or emergency licensing before the first field visit
sop: Check each roster member licence for each affected state.
Accept emergency licences only where the state has granted them.
Withhold assignments from unlicensed resources.
Done when every assignable resource is licensed for its states.
verify: Sample assignments and read licence status.
Pass when every assigned adjuster is licensed for that state.

steps.title: Set the CAT team lead as supervisory contact on each claim
sop: Add the CAT team lead as supervisor on the claim.
Confirm oversight is visible on the claim file rather than held offline.
Update the supervisor when the lead changes shift.
Done when each CAT claim names a CAT supervisor.
verify: Filter CAT claims with no supervisor.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Balance assignments by geographic cluster rather than round-robin
sop: Group the open CAT claims by geographic cluster.
Assign each cluster to adjusters already working that area.
Avoid simple round-robin that scatters travel.
Done when assignments follow geographic clusters.
verify: Read the cluster spread per assigned adjuster.
Pass when each adjuster caseload sits within their cluster.

steps.title: Steer complex and large-loss CAT claims to the large-loss lane
sop: Identify CAT claims above the large-loss threshold or with complexity markers.
Assign them to the large-loss CAT lane.
Do not leave them with a general CAT handler.
Done when large and complex CAT claims sit in the large-loss lane.
verify: Filter CAT claims above threshold by lane.
Pass when each sits in the large-loss lane.

steps.title: Review CAT assignment coverage and capacity daily
sop: Run the daily CAT assignment report by cluster and firm.
Identify clusters with unassigned volume.
Call off additional roster capacity where required.
Done when unassigned CAT volume is covered or escalated.
verify: Re-run the report after call-off.
Pass when no cluster carries unassigned CAT claims past the standard.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every routing and escalation event on a claim requiring a documented rationale.
generic.In-scope period: From intake routing through every subsequent escalation while the claim is open.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger cited, receiving role or unit, decision sought, author and timestamp.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Routing and escalation events equal rationale entries in the claim audit trail.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rationale entries retained in the audit trail with author and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Manual overrides logged with what the rule proposed and who authorised the change.
generic.Test population: All routing and escalation events on claims in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No manual routing override recorded without a documented reason and approver.
generic.Exception handling path: Undocumented events are returned to the Claims Examiner for retrospective rationale.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each routing and escalation event carries a rationale entry with author and timestamp.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter audit trail with rationale entries filed in the document repository.

steps.title: Record why the claim went to its handling track in the ClaimCenter audit trail
sop: State the specific trigger such as injury reported or reserve above threshold.
Reference coverage question or attorney involvement where these drove the track.
Write the entry on the claim audit trail.
Done when the track rationale is recorded against the routing event.
verify: Read the audit entry for the named trigger.
Pass when the entry names a specific trigger.

steps.title: Document overridden automated routing with proposal and authoriser
sop: State what the routing rule proposed.
State what was chosen instead and why.
Name who authorised the change.
Done when the override entry names proposal, choice and authoriser.
verify: Read override entries for the three elements.
Pass when all three appear on each override.

steps.title: Name the receiving role and the decision sought on escalations
sop: State which role or unit the escalation goes to.
State the decision being asked of them.
Avoid vague requests to review the file.
Done when the escalation entry names the receiver and the decision sought.
verify: Read escalation entries for receiver and decision.
Pass when both are named.

steps.title: Keep rationale on the claim audit trail rather than in spreadsheets or chat
sop: Write rationale directly on the claim.
Do not rely on routing spreadsheets or chat threads.
Copy across any rationale currently held outside the system.
Done when the rationale exists on the claim.
verify: Search the audit trail for the event rationale.
Pass when the rationale is present on the claim.

steps.title: Read the routing history end to end as an uninformed reviewer
sop: Read the audit trail from intake to current position.
Identify any step whose reason is not clear.
Ask the examiner to complete the missing rationale.
Done when the history reads coherently end to end.
verify: Re-read the history after completion.
Pass when every routing step has a followable reason.

steps.title: Sample-review rationale entries against the documentation standard
sop: Pull a sample of routed and escalated claims.
Check trigger, receiver, decision sought and authoriser are present.
Return deficient entries for rework.
Done when the sample is reviewed and rework raised.
verify: Read the sample review record.
Pass when every sampled event carries a compliant rationale entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims whose incurred or estimated exposure crosses the large-loss or complexity thresholds.
generic.In-scope period: At intake and after every reserve movement while the claim remains open.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger threshold, key facts, coverage position, current reserve and decision sought.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims above threshold equal claims carrying a completed escalation record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation record retained with the raise timestamp and the acknowledgment timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declined escalations logged with the reason and the agreed handling plan.
generic.Test population: All claims crossing the large-loss threshold in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim above the large-loss threshold without a completed escalation.
generic.Exception handling path: Unacknowledged escalations chase through to the Claims Director within the window.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An escalation record citing the trigger threshold and acknowledged by the reviewer.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter escalation activity and the escalation queue in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Re-check exposure against the large-loss threshold after each reserve movement
sop: Read the current incurred and estimated exposure.
Compare against the large-loss threshold rather than relying on the intake view.
Trigger escalation as soon as the threshold is crossed.
Done when the threshold check is made and recorded.
verify: Compare reserve history against escalation dates.
Pass when escalation followed the first threshold crossing.

steps.title: Move claims above 100K to a senior adjuster in ClaimCenter
sop: Identify claims with incurred above the 100K threshold.
Reassign each to a senior adjuster with adequate authority.
Record the reassignment reason.
Done when above-100K claims sit with a senior adjuster.
verify: Filter above-100K claims by handler seniority.
Pass when each sits with a senior adjuster.

steps.title: Place claims above 500K under claims management oversight
sop: Identify claims with incurred above 500K.
Add claims management as supervisory oversight on each.
Set the management review cadence for the claim.
Done when above-500K claims carry management oversight.
verify: Read the oversight field on above-500K claims.
Pass when each names a manager overseeing it.

steps.title: Write the escalation summary with facts, coverage position and decision sought
sop: Summarise the key facts and the current coverage position.
State the current reserve and what moved it.
State the specific decision being sought.
Done when the summary carries all four elements.
verify: Read the escalation summary for the four elements.
Pass when all four are present.

steps.title: Chase acknowledgment from the receiving senior handler or manager
sop: Track the escalation until it is acknowledged.
Chase within the escalation response window rather than after it.
Record the acknowledgment on the claim.
Done when the escalation is acknowledged and recorded.
verify: Read the acknowledgment timestamp against the window.
Pass when acknowledgment falls inside the window.

steps.title: Record declined escalations with reason and agreed handling plan
sop: Where an escalation is declined state why on the claim.
Record the agreed handling plan and who owns it.
Do not leave a declined escalation silent.
Done when declines carry a reason and a handling plan.
verify: Read declined escalations for reason and plan.
Pass when both are recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims meeting litigation triggers such as attorney representation, suit service or demand letters.
generic.In-scope period: From the trigger date, which drives non-extendable response deadlines.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Litigation flag, trigger type, service or demand date, coverage position and reserve.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims with litigation triggers equal claims carrying a flag and a legal notification.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Suit papers or demand letter retained on the claim with the receipt date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late-identified triggers logged with the date discovered and the remediation taken.
generic.Test population: All claims with a litigation trigger raised in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No served suit or attorney representation on file without a flag and legal notification.
generic.Exception handling path: Deadline risk escalates immediately to the Litigation Manager and Coverage Counsel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Litigation flag set with the trigger date and a legal notification activity recorded.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter litigation panel and the legal notification activity in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Set the litigation flag on the claim when a trigger is present
sop: Check for attorney representation, served suit papers, a demand letter or a fatality or serious injury.
Set the litigation flag naming the trigger type.
Do not wait for suit papers where an attorney has already notified.
Done when the flag is set with its trigger type.
verify: Read the flag and trigger type on the claim.
Pass when both are present on triggered claims.

steps.title: Record the service or demand receipt date in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the date suit papers were served or the demand was received.
Treat that date as the start of the response deadline.
Do not record the date the file was reviewed instead.
Done when the trigger date is recorded on the claim.
verify: Compare the recorded date against the served document.
Pass when the two dates agree.

steps.title: Notify the legal unit with coverage position, reserve and deadline
sop: Raise the legal notification activity in the workflow tool.
Include coverage position, current reserve and the response deadline.
Attach the suit papers or demand letter.
Done when the notification is raised with all three elements.
verify: Read the notification content and attachments.
Pass when position, reserve and deadline are all included.

steps.title: Review the reserve for legal exposure and defence costs
sop: Reassess indemnity for litigated exposure.
Add an expense reserve for defence costs.
Do not leave the reserve at the pre-litigation level.
Done when reserves reflect the litigated position.
verify: Compare reserves before and after the flag date.
Pass when the reserve was reviewed at the flag point.

steps.title: Instruct defence counsel from the approved panel and record it
sop: Select counsel from the approved panel for the jurisdiction.
Record the instruction and the counsel reference on the claim.
Do not instruct off-panel firms without documented approval.
Done when the panel instruction is recorded.
verify: Read the counsel record against the approved panel list.
Pass when the instructed firm is on panel or carries approval.

steps.title: Review coverage questions with Coverage Counsel before the deadline
sop: Review the coverage position on flagged claims.
Advise on reservation of rights or declination where required.
Record the advice on the claim before the response deadline.
Done when coverage advice is recorded ahead of the deadline.
verify: Compare advice date against the response deadline.
Pass when advice was recorded before the deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every newly assigned claim requiring an intake task list and customer contact SLA tasks.
generic.In-scope period: From assignment through the SLA windows attached to the generated tasks.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Task type, owner, due date and the SLA source driving each due date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims assigned equals claims carrying a generated task list on the diary.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Task list retained on the claim with its generation timestamp and template version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Tasks generated without an owner or due date logged and corrected before release.
generic.Test population: All task lists generated on claims assigned in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No generated task without a due date or an owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Template gaps escalate to the Claims Coordinator for configuration correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A task list with owners and SLA-derived due dates is attached to the claim.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter activity list and the task template configuration in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Generate the task list matching claim type and severity tier
sop: Trigger task generation from the assignment event.
Confirm the template matches claim type and severity tier.
Do not accept a single generic list for all claims.
Done when the generated list matches the claim profile.
verify: Read the template id against the claim type and tier.
Pass when the template matches both.

steps.title: Date the customer contact task to the 24-hour standard from assignment
sop: Set the contact task due date 24 hours from assignment.
Confirm the clock runs from assignment and not from generation.
Correct any longer default.
Done when the contact task is due inside 24 hours.
verify: Read the contact task due date against assignment time.
Pass when it falls inside 24 hours.

steps.title: Confirm coverage, reserve and evidence tasks are present with due dates
sop: Check the list carries coverage verification, reserve setting and evidence collection tasks.
Confirm each due date sits inside its own standard.
Add any missing task manually and flag the template gap.
Done when all three tasks exist with compliant due dates.
verify: Read the three tasks and their due dates.
Pass when each exists inside its standard.

steps.title: Apply state-specific deadlines where they are shorter than the default
sop: Read the loss jurisdiction acknowledgment and contact deadlines.
Override the generic default where the state deadline is shorter.
Record which deadline source applies.
Done when the shorter applicable deadline is in force.
verify: Compare task due dates against the state deadlines.
Pass when the shorter deadline was applied.

steps.title: Assign an owner to every generated task
sop: Set the named owner on each task rather than a group.
Reassign tasks that generated without an owner.
Do not release the claim with ownerless tasks.
Done when every task carries a named owner.
verify: Filter tasks with no owner on the claim.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Confirm tasks and SLA clocks surface on the adjuster diary
sop: Open the diary view as the assigned adjuster.
Confirm every generated task appears with its due date.
Raise a defect where tasks stay inside the routing engine only.
Done when the diary shows the full task list.
verify: Compare the diary against the generated task list.
Pass when the lists match.

steps.title: Publish matching content on the portal and the IVR announcement
