Update the Genesys IVR announcement with the same routes and hours.
Do not let channels carry contradicting information.
Done when portal and IVR carry the same content.
verify: Compare portal text and IVR script against the sent message.
Pass when all three agree.

steps.title: Send the campaign and record delivery outcomes
sop: Release the campaign from CRM to the scoped list.
Record the send timestamp and the delivery results.
Attempt an alternate channel for undeliverable recipients.
Done when the campaign is sent and outcomes recorded.
verify: Read the campaign delivery report.
Pass when undeliverables carry an alternate-channel attempt.

generic.Defined scope/population: The declaration decision and every activation action taken for the declared CAT event.
generic.In-scope period: From the declaration timestamp through the activation phase of the response.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Decision, authorising role, declaration timestamp and each activation action with its time.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Activation actions listed in the response plan equal actions logged on the event record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Trigger evidence attached to the event record with its issue date and source.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Actions taken out of sequence or skipped logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All activation actions recorded for the declared event.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No activation action recorded only outside the claims system.
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps in the log escalate to the Claims Director for retrospective completion.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A timestamped activation log with attached trigger evidence on the event record.
generic.Evidence location: CAT event record in the claims platform with attachments in the document repository.

steps.title: Log the declaration decision, authorising role and timestamp
sop: Record the decision to declare on the event record.
Record who authorised it and when.
Do not rely on the email announcing the declaration.
Done when decision, role and timestamp are logged.
verify: Read the declaration entry on the event record.
Pass when all three elements are present.

steps.title: Attach the trigger evidence to the event record
sop: Attach the meteorological bulletin, PCS designation or regulator order.
Record the source and issue date of each item.
Confirm attachments open and are legible.
Done when trigger evidence is attached and readable.
verify: Open each attachment from the event record.
Pass when the trigger evidence is present and legible.

steps.title: Record each activation action with its time in the claims platform
sop: Log command stand-up, queue creation, roster call-off, vendor activation and policyholder communication.
Record the time each action was completed.
Do not batch-log actions with a single timestamp.
Done when each action carries its own completion time.
verify: Read the activation log entries and times.
Pass when each planned action has its own timed entry.

steps.title: Move any log held in spreadsheets or chat onto the event record
sop: Collect activation notes kept in personal spreadsheets or incident chat.
Transfer them to the event record.
Note the original source and time.
Done when no activation record lives only outside the system.
verify: Compare the incident chat against the event log.
Pass when every action in chat also appears on the event record.

steps.title: Check the log supports a post-event review and external enquiry
sop: Read the log as an outside reviewer would.
Identify actions whose timing or owner is unclear.
Complete the missing detail.
Done when the log is self-explanatory end to end.
verify: Re-read the completed log.
Pass when each action shows what was done, by whom and when.

steps.title: Review activation log completeness against the response plan
sop: Compare the log against the activation checklist in the response plan.
Record why any planned action was skipped.
Sign off the log as complete for the activation phase.
Done when the log is reconciled to the plan and signed off.
verify: Read the sign-off and the skipped-action reasons.
Pass when every plan action is logged or explained.

generic.Defined scope/population: Internal CAT adjusters, independent adjuster firms and restoration vendors for the affected region.
generic.In-scope period: From event declaration through the deployment ramp, refreshed daily as volume clarifies.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Deployed headcount by firm and geography, licence status and travel arrangements.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Projected claim volume by geography reconciles to deployed capacity on the roster.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Deployment roster retained on the event record with daily version and update time.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Capacity shortfalls logged with the additional call-off raised and its outcome.
generic.Test population: All resources deployed against the declared event in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No deployed adjuster taking assignments without a valid or emergency state licence.
generic.Exception handling path: Licensing or capacity blocks escalate to the Claims Director for alternative sourcing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A deployed resource roster with firm, geography and licence status for the event.
generic.Evidence location: CAT event roster in ClaimCenter with vendor call-off records in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Call off internal CAT team, IA firms and restoration vendors
sop: Trigger call-off against the pre-agreed CAT rate and capacity agreements.
Confirm each firm acceptance and the headcount they commit.
Do not negotiate new rates during the surge.
Done when call-off is issued and acceptances are recorded.
verify: Read the call-off acceptances on the event record.
Pass when each firm has recorded a committed headcount.

steps.title: Confirm emergency licensing or state registration before assignments
sop: Check each deployed resource licence or emergency registration for their state.
Withhold assignments until registration is confirmed.
Record the licence status on the roster.
Done when every deployed resource shows a valid licence status.
verify: Read licence status per roster line.
Pass when no unlicensed resource holds assignments.

steps.title: Match deployed capacity to projected volume by geography
sop: Read the projected claim volume by geography.
Allocate deployed headcount to match the projection.
Update the allocation daily as actual volume emerges.
Done when capacity is allocated against the current projection.
verify: Compare deployed headcount against projected volume per area.
Pass when each area has capacity matched to its projection.

steps.title: Confirm travel, accommodation and safety arrangements for field resources
sop: Book or confirm travel and accommodation for deploying resources.
Confirm the safety briefing has been delivered for the affected area.
Record confirmations against each roster line.
Done when arrangements are confirmed for every deploying resource.
verify: Read the arrangements column on the roster.
Pass when each deploying resource shows confirmed arrangements.

steps.title: Record deployed headcount by firm and geography on the event record
sop: Report daily on-site headcount by firm and area.
Record it on the event roster.
Flag no-shows and early departures.
Done when the roster reflects actual on-site headcount.
verify: Compare reported headcount against the roster.
Pass when the roster matches the on-site position.

steps.title: Review capacity against volume daily and call off more if needed
sop: Compare inspection backlog against deployed capacity each day.
Raise additional call-off where the backlog is growing.
Record the decision and the additional headcount requested.
Done when the daily capacity decision is recorded.
verify: Read the daily capacity decisions on the event record.
Pass when each day carries a recorded decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: The standing CAT notification distribution including command, leadership and support functions.
generic.In-scope period: The activation window defined in the CAT response plan for the declared event.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Event definition, severity level, expected volume and first situation-report time.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Distribution list members equal recorded acknowledgments plus chased non-acknowledgers.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification and acknowledgments retained on the event record with timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Non-acknowledgers logged with the chase route used and the eventual response.
generic.Test population: All notified command roles and leadership recipients for the event.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No command role holder left unacknowledged past the activation window.
generic.Exception handling path: Persistent non-acknowledgment escalates to the Chief Claims Officer for role backfill.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification sent to the full CAT distribution with acknowledgments recorded per role.
generic.Evidence location: CAT event record in the claims platform with the CRM notification send log.

steps.title: Send the declaration notification to the standing CAT distribution
sop: Send to command team, claims leadership, underwriting, reinsurance, exposure management, finance and communications.
Use the standing distribution rather than an ad hoc address list.
Record the send timestamp on the event record.
Done when the notification is sent to the full distribution.
verify: Compare recipients against the standing distribution list.
Pass when no listed function was omitted.

steps.title: Include event definition, severity, expected volume and first report time
sop: State peril, geography and date window in the notification.
State the severity level and expected claim volume.
State the time of the first situation report.
Done when all four elements appear in the notification.
verify: Read the notification content.
Pass when definition, severity, volume and report time are all present.

steps.title: Collect acknowledgment from each command role holder
sop: Require an explicit acknowledgment from each command role.
Do not treat a sent email as notification complete.
Record each acknowledgment against the role.
Done when acknowledgments are recorded per command role.
verify: Read the acknowledgment list against the command roles.
Pass when each role shows an acknowledgment.

steps.title: Chase non-acknowledgers through the escalation contact route
sop: Identify roles unacknowledged inside the activation window.
Chase through the escalation contact route in the plan.
Record the chase attempt and its outcome.
Done when every non-acknowledger has been chased.
verify: Read the chase records against unacknowledged roles.
Pass when each carries a chase attempt.

steps.title: Record notification and acknowledgments on the event record
sop: Log the notification content and send time on the event record.
Log each acknowledgment with its timestamp.
Do not leave activation readiness evidenced only in mailboxes.
Done when notification and acknowledgments are on the event record.
verify: Read the event record notification section.
Pass when content, send time and acknowledgments are all recorded.

steps.title: Backfill command roles that remain unacknowledged
sop: Review roles still unacknowledged at the end of the activation window.
Appoint an interim holder for each.
Record the backfill on the event record.
Done when every command role has an available holder.
verify: Read the command role list after backfill.
Pass when no role is left without an available holder.

generic.Defined scope/population: Candidate CAT triggers from meteorological services, PCS designations, emergency orders or volume surges.
generic.In-scope period: From trigger receipt to the validation decision, before any declaration is made.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger source, event footprint, exposure assessment, date window and peril.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: In-force exposure inside the footprint reconciles to the exposure figures used in the assessment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Source document retained with issue date and the validation decision timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Decisions not to declare recorded so near-miss events are evidenced.
generic.Test population: All candidate triggers assessed in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No CAT event declared without a validated trigger from an approved source.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous or unofficial triggers escalate to the Claims Director before any declaration.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A validation record citing the approved event source and the exposure assessment.
generic.Evidence location: CAT event validation record in the claims platform with BI exposure reports.

steps.title: Confirm the trigger comes from an approved source
sop: Check the trigger against national meteorological service, PCS designation or an official emergency declaration.
Reject news reporting as a standalone trigger.
Attach the source document to the validation record.
Done when an approved source document is attached.
verify: Read the attached source.
Pass when it is from an approved source type.

steps.title: Assess the event footprint against in-force exposure on the BI platform
sop: Overlay the reported footprint on in-force exposure by geography.
Quantify policies and sums insured inside the footprint.
Do not judge the trigger on event size alone.
Done when the exposure assessment is produced.
verify: Read the exposure figures in the assessment.
Pass when in-force exposure inside the footprint is quantified.

steps.title: Validate volume-driven surge triggers against the plan threshold
sop: Where no named event exists compare intake volume against the surge threshold.
Use the threshold defined in the CAT response plan.
Record the volume observed against the threshold.
Done when the volume comparison is recorded.
verify: Read the recorded volume against the plan threshold.
Pass when the comparison is documented.

steps.title: Define the event date window and peril precisely enough to configure tagging
sop: Set a precise start and end including any tail.
Name the peril in the terms the tagger uses.
Remove ambiguity that would sweep unrelated losses in.
Done when window and peril are unambiguous.
verify: Attempt a tagging configuration using the definition.
Pass when the definition configures without ambiguity.

steps.title: Record the validation decision including a decision not to declare
sop: Record whether the trigger is validated for declaration.
Record near-miss decisions with the reasoning.
Do not leave rejected triggers unrecorded.
Done when the decision and reasoning are recorded.
verify: Read the validation records for the period.
Pass when every assessed trigger carries a decision.

steps.title: Review the validation before any declaration proceeds
sop: Read the source, exposure assessment and definition.
Challenge any gap before declaration.
Sign off the validation as complete.
Done when the validation is signed off or returned.
verify: Read the sign-off on the validation record.
Pass when declaration followed a signed-off validation.

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims correctly tagged to the declared CAT event for aggregate loss reporting.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting cycle for the event with figures cut at the agreed daily snapshot time.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Paid, outstanding, incurred, IBNR allowance and the state, line and peril splits.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Aggregate figures reconcile to the claims financial ledger with variances explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Aggregate output retained with cut time, data version and preparer.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Untagged suspect claims counted and reported alongside the aggregate.
generic.Test population: All event-tagged claims included in the aggregate for the reporting cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim included in the aggregate that is not tagged to the declared event.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled ledger variances escalate to the Reserving Actuary before circulation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A dated aggregate split by paid, outstanding and IBNR with a ledger reconciliation.
generic.Evidence location: BI reporting platform event aggregate with the ClaimCenter financial extract.

steps.title: Extract paid, outstanding and incurred by event from ClaimCenter
sop: Run the event financial extract at the agreed cut time.
Split indemnity from expense in the extract.
Record the cut time and data version.
Done when the split extract is produced for the cycle.
verify: Read the extract header for cut time and version.
Pass when both are recorded.

steps.title: Add an IBNR or late-notification allowance to the aggregate
sop: Estimate late-reported claim volume using the reporting pattern for the peril.
Add the allowance to the aggregate.
State the method used for the allowance.
Done when the aggregate includes a stated IBNR allowance.
verify: Read the allowance and its stated method.
Pass when both appear in the aggregate pack.

steps.title: Break the aggregate by state, line of business and peril
sop: Produce the splits needed for regulatory and reinsurance views.
Confirm the splits sum to the total.
Do not leave the views to be rebuilt downstream.
Done when the three splits are produced and sum correctly.
verify: Sum each split against the aggregate total.
Pass when each split reconciles to the total.

steps.title: Reconcile the aggregate to the claims financial ledger
sop: Compare aggregate paid and outstanding against the ledger.
Investigate and explain each variance.
Do not circulate before the reconciliation is complete.
Done when the reconciliation is complete with variances explained.
verify: Read the reconciliation statement.
Pass when every variance carries an explanation.

steps.title: Confirm only correctly tagged claims are in the aggregate
sop: Sample aggregate claims for a valid event tag.
Remove any claim not tagged to the declared event.
Count untagged suspects still under review and report the number.
Done when the aggregate holds only tagged claims and suspects are counted.
verify: Read the tag status of aggregate claims.
Pass when every aggregate claim carries the event tag.

steps.title: Publish the dated aggregate to the CAT distribution
sop: Publish the aggregate on the BI platform at the agreed time.
Include the cut time, splits, IBNR and reconciliation note.
Record the publication on the event record.
Done when the aggregate is published and recorded.
verify: Read the published pack for the required contents.
Pass when all required elements are present and dated.

generic.Defined scope/population: On-site inspections of event-damaged properties assigned to the field adjuster.
generic.In-scope period: The inspection visit itself, with findings recorded before leaving the property.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Photo set, itemised estimate, pre-existing damage notes, inspection date, time and GPS.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Inspections completed equal claims carrying a dated geo-stamped inspection record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Photographs and estimate retained on the claim with capture timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Scope items in dispute recorded with the insured position and the adjuster position.
generic.Test population: All inspections completed in the review window for the event.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No inspection recorded without supporting photographs linked to the exposure.
generic.Exception handling path: Access refusals or unsafe conditions abort the visit and raise a rebooking activity.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A dated geo-stamped inspection record with an itemised estimate and photo set.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter inspection record with photographs in the claim file document repository.

steps.title: Capture the full photo set on site into the mobile claim application
sop: Photograph elevations, roof, interior room by room and serial or model plates.
Take a wide shot establishing the address.
Upload the set to the claim before leaving the area.
Done when the full photo set is attached to the claim.
verify: Read the photo set against the required shot list.
Pass when every required shot is present.

steps.title: Record the damage estimate on the itemised estimating template
sop: Enter scope line by line on the estimating template.
Avoid a single lump-sum figure.
Confirm quantities and rates are populated per line.
Done when the itemised estimate is complete on the claim.
verify: Read the estimate for line-level detail.
Pass when the estimate is itemised rather than lump sum.

steps.title: Note pre-existing damage and wear separately from event damage
sop: Photograph and describe pre-existing damage, wear and maintenance issues.
Record them under a separate heading from event damage.
Do not merge them into the event scope.
Done when pre-existing items are recorded separately.
verify: Read the record for a separate pre-existing section.
Pass when pre-existing items are distinguishable from event damage.

steps.title: Stamp inspection date, time and GPS location against the visit
sop: Confirm the mobile application captured date, time and GPS at the property.
Correct or note any capture failure before leaving.
Attach the stamp to the inspection record.
Done when the visit carries date, time and GPS.
verify: Read the inspection record stamps.
Pass when all three are present and match the property.

steps.title: Agree scope with the insured or contractor before leaving
sop: Walk the scope with the insured or their contractor on site.
Record what is agreed and what remains in dispute.
Do not leave the property with the scope unaddressed.
Done when agreed and disputed scope are both recorded.
verify: Read the scope agreement section.
Pass when agreement and disputes are both recorded.

steps.title: Review inspection records for completeness against the standard
sop: Sample completed inspections for photos, itemisation and stamps.
Return incomplete records for completion.
Record the review outcome.
Done when the sample is reviewed and rework raised.
verify: Read the review outcome record.
Pass when no sampled inspection lacks photographs linked to the exposure.

generic.Defined scope/population: CAT property claims requiring triage into total loss, major, minor or no damage.
generic.In-scope period: The event triage window before full inspections are booked.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Triage outcome, assessment method, imagery date and the resulting handling route.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: CAT property claims equal claims carrying a recorded triage outcome.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Imagery or drive-by evidence retained with its capture date on the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims that cannot be triaged remotely logged for a booked physical inspection.
generic.Test population: All CAT property claims raised for the event in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No untriaged CAT property claim beyond the event triage window.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed remote assessments escalate to the Catastrophe & Exposure Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each CAT property claim carries a triage outcome with method and date.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter triage field with imagery evidence held in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Sort properties using drive-by, aerial or drone survey
sop: Assess each property as total loss, major repairable, minor repairable or no damage.
Use drive-by, aerial imagery or drone survey rather than booking full inspections first.
Record the outcome per claim.
Done when every claim in the batch has a triage outcome.
verify: Read triage outcomes across the batch.
Pass when no claim in the batch is untriaged.

steps.title: Confirm the imagery date postdates the event
sop: Read the capture date on the imagery used.
Reject imagery captured before the event date.
Record the imagery date against the triage outcome.
Done when the imagery used postdates the event.
verify: Compare imagery dates against the event date.
Pass when every triage used post-event imagery.

steps.title: Fast-track clear total losses to advance payment and ALE
sop: Identify clear total losses from the triage.
Raise advance payment and additional living expense authorisation.
Do not queue them behind full inspections.
Done when total losses carry advance payment and ALE activities.
verify: Read the activities on total-loss claims.
Pass when each carries advance payment and ALE actions.

steps.title: Move no-damage and minor cases to desk or virtual adjustment
sop: Close no-damage cases or move them to desk handling.
Route minor repairable cases to virtual adjustment.
Free field capacity for the severe end.
Done when minor and no-damage cases are off the field queue.
verify: Read the field queue composition after triage.
Pass when the field queue holds mainly major and total losses.

steps.title: Record the triage basis on each claim
sop: Record whether the basis was aerial, drive-by or insured-supplied photos.
Store it against the triage outcome.
Do not leave the assessment method unstated.
Done when every triage outcome names its basis.
verify: Read the basis field on triaged claims.
Pass when each names an assessment method.

steps.title: Review untriaged CAT property claims against the triage window
sop: Run the untriaged CAT property claim list daily.
Assign remaining claims to a triage resource.
Escalate capacity shortfalls.
Done when the untriaged list is cleared inside the window.
verify: Re-run the untriaged list at window close.
Pass when it returns no claims.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full CAT response for the closed event including vendors, cycle times and file quality.
generic.In-scope period: From event declaration to event stand-down, reviewed once claims volume has settled.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Measured metrics, vendor performance findings, failure themes and owned improvement actions.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sampled closed CAT files reconcile to the claim population reported for the event.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review pack retained with data cut dates and the review completion date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Operational failures logged as themed findings with owners and target dates.
generic.Test population: Closed CAT files sampled against the quality scorecard for the event.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No post-event review action left without an owner or a due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Findings needing plan changes route to the Claims Director for CAT plan update.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A completed post-event review with measured metrics and owned improvement actions.
generic.Evidence location: BI reporting platform review pack with closed files in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Measure actual performance against the response plan on the BI platform
sop: Measure activation lead time, first contact and inspection cycle times.
Measure payment velocity and complaint volume.
Compare each against the plan target.
Done when each metric is measured against target.
verify: Read the metric table in the review pack.
Pass when every metric shows actual against target.

steps.title: Review vendor and IA performance against CAT commitments
sop: Compare delivered capacity and quality against the CAT agreements.
Record findings per firm for the panel review.
Do not generalise across all vendors.
Done when each firm carries a recorded finding.
verify: Read the vendor findings section.
Pass when each engaged firm has a recorded finding.

steps.title: Capture operational failures as themed findings
sop: Record routing gaps, licensing delays, communication breakdowns and system capacity limits.
Group them into themes rather than a long incident list.
State the impact of each theme.
Done when failures are themed with stated impact.
verify: Read the themed findings.
Pass when each theme states its operational impact.

steps.title: Sample-review closed CAT files against the quality scorecard
sop: Pull a representative sample of closed CAT files.
Score them against the quality scorecard.
Compare scores against the pre-event baseline.
Done when the sample is scored and compared.
verify: Read the sample scores against baseline.
Pass when the comparison is documented.

steps.title: Log improvement actions with owners and dates
sop: Convert each finding into an improvement action.
Assign an owner and a due date to each.
Do not leave findings sitting in the report.
Done when every finding has an owned dated action.
verify: Read the action log against the findings.
Pass when no finding lacks an owner or date.

steps.title: Feed the actions into the CAT response plan update
sop: Review actions that require a plan change.
Raise the plan update and set the publication date.
Track the actions through to completion.
Done when plan changes are raised and tracked.
verify: Read the plan update record.
Pass when each plan-affecting action is reflected in the update.

generic.Defined scope/population: Event aggregate losses and individual large losses subject to treaty and facultative reporting.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty loss occurrence period defined by the hours clause for the event.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Event aggregate, attachment point, hours-clause basis, bordereau splits and ceded figures.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded figures reconcile to the gross event aggregate with movements explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reinsurer notifications retained with send date and the aggregate version reported.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late or corrected notifications logged with the reason and the corrected figures.
generic.Test population: All treaty and facultative reportable losses for the event in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No facultative-covered large loss unreported beyond the 72-hour standard.
generic.Exception handling path: Attachment point uncertainty escalates to the Catastrophe & Exposure Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A dated reinsurer notification with event aggregate and hours-clause basis.
generic.Evidence location: Treaty repository notification record with the BI event aggregate extract.

steps.title: Measure the event aggregate against the CAT treaty attachment point
sop: Read the current event aggregate from the BI platform.
Compare it against the treaty attachment point in the treaty repository.
Notify the reinsurer as the point is approached rather than after breach.
Done when the position against attachment is measured and notified.
verify: Read the notification date against the aggregate trend.
Pass when notification preceded the breach.

steps.title: Apply the treaty hours clause to define the loss occurrence period
sop: Read the hours clause for the peril in the treaty.
Define the occurrence period and group claims accordingly.
Record the chosen basis and the reasoning.
Done when the occurrence period is defined and recorded.
verify: Read the recorded hours-clause basis.
Pass when the basis and reasoning are documented.

steps.title: Notify facultative reinsurers on individual large losses within 72 hours
sop: Identify facultative-covered losses breaching the reporting trigger.
Notify each facultative reinsurer within the 72-hour standard.
Record the notification on the claim and in the treaty repository.
Done when each qualifying loss is notified inside 72 hours.
verify: Compare notification dates against trigger dates.
Pass when every notification falls inside 72 hours.

steps.title: Provide the loss bordereau in the contractual format and cadence
sop: Produce the bordereau split by state, peril and line.
Match the contractual format and submission cadence.
Do not substitute an internal report format.
Done when the bordereau is issued in the contractual form.
verify: Compare the issued bordereau against the contractual template.
Pass when format and cadence match the treaty terms.

steps.title: Reconcile ceded figures to the gross event aggregate
sop: Compare ceded amounts against the gross aggregate.
Explain movements between reporting cycles.
Correct any ceding error before submission.
Done when ceded and gross figures reconcile with explanations.
verify: Read the reconciliation statement.
Pass when movements between cycles are explained.

steps.title: Review the reinsurance reporting position for the event
sop: Review notifications, bordereaux and the attachment position.
Identify anything unreported or overdue.
Record the review on the event record.
Done when the review is recorded and gaps are actioned.
verify: Read the review record and open gaps.
Pass when no reportable loss remains unnotified.

generic.Defined scope/population: Field adjusters and independent appraisers deploying into the affected geography for the event.
generic.In-scope period: The deployment cycle, replanned daily as inspection demand and access change.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Geographic cluster, priority order, licence status, safety briefing and mobile app access.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Inspections to be booked reconcile to daily inspection capacity across deployed adjusters.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Deployment plan retained with its version, planning date and cluster allocations.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Areas closed by emergency services logged as excluded until access is confirmed.
generic.Test population: All inspection assignments released for the event in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No inspection assigned in an area flagged as closed or unsafe for access.
generic.Exception handling path: Access or capacity blocks escalate to the Claims Director for replanning.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A deployment plan assigning adjusters to clusters with priority-ordered routing.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter assignment records with the deployment plan in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Allocate adjusters and appraisers by geographic cluster
sop: Group open inspections into geographic clusters.
Allocate each cluster to a field resource already in that area.
Minimise travel time between inspections.
Done when every cluster has an allocated resource.
verify: Read the cluster allocation table.
Pass when each cluster shows an allocated resource.

steps.title: Order routing by severity and vulnerability
sop: Place uninhabitable properties and displaced or injured insureds first.
Prioritise vulnerable customers ahead of routine cases.
Record the priority order in the route plan.
Done when the route plan reflects severity and vulnerability.
verify: Read the route ordering against the priority flags.
Pass when priority cases sit at the front of the route.

steps.title: Confirm licensing, safety briefing and mobile app access before release
sop: Check active state licensing for each deploying resource.
Confirm the safety briefing was delivered and mobile claim app access works.
Hold assignments until all three are confirmed.
Done when each deploying resource clears all three checks.
verify: Read the readiness checklist per resource.
Pass when no resource holds assignments without clearing the checks.

steps.title: Set realistic daily inspection capacity per adjuster
sop: Set the per-adjuster daily inspection limit for CAT conditions.
Load queues to that limit rather than beyond it.
Adjust the limit as field conditions change.
Done when queues respect the daily capacity limit.
verify: Compare assigned inspections against the daily limit.
Pass when no adjuster is loaded beyond the limit.

steps.title: Exclude areas closed by emergency services from routing

Exclude closed or unsafe areas from routing.
Reinstate them once access is confirmed safe.

steps.title: Replan deployment daily against inspection backlog
sop: Compare completed inspections against the backlog each evening.
Reallocate resources between clusters where the backlog is uneven.
Record the replanning decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims where incurred cost has moved beyond the published reserve tolerance.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Deterioration amount, driver, approval reference and the escalation response date.

generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation activity retained with the reserve movement history and approval record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Movements above threshold without prior approval logged and remediated.
generic.Test population: All reserve movements recorded on event claims in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No reserve movement above the approval threshold posted without manager approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Event-level deterioration escalates to exposure management and reinsurance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Deterioration beyond tolerance carries an escalation activity citing driver and approval.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter financial history with the deterioration report on the BI platform.

steps.title: Run the reserve deterioration report on the BI platform
sop: List claims where incurred exceeds reserve beyond the published tolerance.
Include claims moving past an authority threshold.
Record the report date and the claims returned.
Done when the deterioration list is produced.
verify: Read the report date and claim list.
Pass when the list covers the current review cycle.

steps.title: State the driver of the deterioration on each claim
sop: Identify scope increase, hidden damage, material or labour inflation or a new injury.
Record the driver on the claim.
Avoid recording deterioration with no stated cause.
Done when each deteriorating claim names its driver.
verify: Read the driver field on the listed claims.
Pass when each names a driver.

steps.title: Capture manager approval for changes above the 25K threshold
sop: Review reserve changes above the 25K change threshold.
Record approval before the change is posted.
Move claims above 500K under management oversight.
Done when approvals are recorded ahead of postings.
verify: Compare approval timestamps against posting timestamps.

steps.title: Escalate event-level deterioration to exposure management and reinsurance
sop: Assess whether the deterioration changes the position against the treaty attachment.
Escalate to exposure management and reinsurance where it does.
Record the escalation on the event record.
Done when event-level escalations are raised and recorded.
verify: Read the escalation record on the event.
Pass when treaty-relevant deterioration was escalated.

steps.title: Raise the escalation as an owned activity with a response date
sop: Create an escalation activity rather than a routine file note.
Assign an owner and set the response date.
Track it until it is answered.
Done when the escalation activity exists with owner and date.
verify: Read the escalation activity fields.
Pass when owner and response date are both set.

steps.title: Review deterioration escalations against reserving expectations
sop: Compare deterioration drivers against the reserving assumptions.
Flag drivers that indicate a systemic assumption gap.
Feed findings into the event adequacy review.
Done when the driver review is recorded.
verify: Read the driver review record.
Pass when systemic drivers are identified and passed on.

generic.Defined scope/population: Daily CAT metrics covering claim volume, reserves, payment velocity and cycle times.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A dated daily pack with volume, reserve, payment-velocity and cycle-time metrics.

steps.title: Fix the daily cut-off and publication times on the BI platform

Set the publication time for the pack.
Communicate both to the CAT distribution.

verify: Read the times stated on the pack.

steps.title: Include volume, inventory, reserve and payment metrics in the pack
sop: Report claims received and closed and the open inventory.
Report average reserve, paid to date and payment velocity.
Do not omit metrics because the figure looks poor.
Done when all six metrics are in the pack.
verify: Read the pack metric list.
Pass when all six metrics are present.

steps.title: Report cycle times against the extended regulatory timeframes in force
sop: Read the extended timeframes configured for the event states.
Measure cycle times against those clocks rather than the standard defaults.
State which timeframe basis was used.
Done when cycle times are reported on the correct basis.
verify: Read the stated timeframe basis on the pack.
Pass when it names the event extended timeframes.

steps.title: Show inspection completion and adjuster capacity utilisation
sop: Report inspections booked, completed and outstanding.
Report capacity utilisation per cluster.
Present it so field resourcing decisions have a basis.

verify: Read the inspection and capacity section.
Pass when both metrics are present by cluster.

steps.title: Assign an accountable owner to each metric
sop: Name the owner accountable for each metric movement.
Publish the ownership alongside the pack.
Do not publish unowned metrics.
Done when every metric carries a named owner.
verify: Read the owner column on the pack.

steps.title: Publish to the standing CAT distribution and record the publication
sop: Publish the pack to the CAT distribution at the fixed time.
Record the publication on the event record.
Log any missed publication with its reason.

verify: Read the publication log for the event days.

generic.Defined scope/population: The event-level reserve position across all claims tagged to the declared CAT event.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Stale reserves identified and logged with the handler action required.
generic.Test population: All open CAT claims tagged to the event at the adequacy review date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No material open CAT claim carrying an unchanged intake reserve past the review cadence.
generic.Exception handling path: Recommended bulk reserve movements route to actuarial and finance for review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A dated event-level adequacy assessment with method, assumptions and conclusion.
generic.Evidence location: BI reporting platform adequacy pack with the ClaimCenter reserve extract.

steps.title: Compare average incurred per claim against the pre-event benchmark
sop: Read the average incurred per claim for the event.
Compare it against the benchmark for the peril.
Adjust the event assumption where the figures diverge.
Done when the comparison and any assumption change are recorded.
verify: Read the recorded comparison.

steps.title: Assess late-reported volume against the expected reporting pattern
sop: Plot reported claim volume against the expected pattern for the peril.
Adjust the IBNR allowance where reporting is running ahead or behind.
State the revised allowance and its basis.
Done when the IBNR allowance reflects the observed pattern.
verify: Read the allowance and its basis.
Pass when the basis references the observed reporting pattern.

steps.title: Identify open claims whose reserves have not moved since intake
sop: Filter open CAT claims with reserves unchanged since intake.
Rank them by size so material cases surface first.
Send the list to the handling managers for action.
Done when the stale reserve list is produced and issued.
verify: Read the stale reserve list and its distribution.
Pass when material stale reserves are listed and issued.

steps.title: Factor demand-surge inflation into the event adequacy view
sop: Estimate materials and labour inflation in the affected region.
Apply it at event level rather than only on individual claims.
State the surge assumption used.
Done when the surge assumption is applied and stated.
verify: Read the stated surge assumption.
Pass when it is quantified in the adequacy view.

steps.title: Record the adequacy conclusion and any recommended bulk movement
sop: State whether the event reserve is adequate, deficient or redundant.
Record the method and assumptions behind the conclusion.
Recommend any bulk reserve movement for actuarial and finance review.
Done when the conclusion and recommendation are recorded.
verify: Read the adequacy record for method, assumptions and conclusion.
Pass when all three are present.

steps.title: Review the adequacy pack with claims management
sop: Review the conclusion and the stale reserve position.
Agree the handler actions arising from the review.
Record the agreed actions with owners.
Done when the review and actions are recorded.
verify: Read the recorded actions from the review.
Pass when each action carries an owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: Accumulated exposure for the event by aggregation zone including in-force risk not yet claimed.

Explain divergence as claims mature.

steps.title: Track the position against reinsurance attachment points and per-event limits

Track accumulation against each.

Include the unclaimed exposure in the ultimate accumulation view.
Do not limit the view to reported claims.

sop: Publish to exposure management, reinsurance and finance on the agreed cadence.

verify: Read the publication log for the active cycles.

steps.title: Escalate concentration breaches to reinsurance
sop: Identify zones breaching the concentration tolerance.
Escalate to reinsurance and exposure management.
Record the escalation and the response.

verify: Read escalations against breaching zones.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open CAT claims measured against the closure and decision timeframes for their loss state.

Order them by remaining time.
Issue the worklist to the handling managers.

sop: Identify claims held open for SIU, litigation or coverage review.

Chase handlers where the justification is missing.

sop: Read the status-letter interval required by each state.

Raise an activity where a letter is overdue.

sop: Summarise breaches and near-breaches by loss state.

Issue the summary on the reporting cadence.

sop: Assign remediation for each breach to a named handler.

Track remediation to completion.
